works.technique: Developed with NHK Science & Technology Research Laboratories: a high-speed projector illuminates the rotating model with a moving slit of light, so each horizontal slice is seen at a different rotation angle.
works.technique_zh: 与 NHK 放送技术研究所合作开发：高速投影机用移动的光缝照亮旋转模型，使每一条水平切片在不同的旋转角度被看到。
works.exercise_en: Rotate a scanned real object in AR and offset each horizontal slice's rotation by its height using a vertex shader. Twist: let the viewer's phone tilt control how much the object twists.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中旋转一个扫描来的真实物体，用顶点着色器按高度偏移每一层切片的旋转角。变体：让手机倾角控制物体扭曲的程度。

works.title: Music Plays Images x Images Play Music (with Ryuichi Sakamoto)
works.description: Ryuichi Sakamoto plays a self-playing grand piano while images projected onto a scrim above the keys both respond to and trigger the notes, so music and image perform together.
works.description_zh: 坂本龙一弹奏一台自动钢琴，投影在琴键上方纱幕上的影像既回应音符又触发音符，音乐与影像同台演出。
works.idea_en: Placing imagery exactly over the source of sound fuses the two senses; AR music visuals work best when they sit on the instrument itself.
works.idea_zh: 把影像精确放在声音来源的上方，会让两种感官融为一体；AR 音乐视觉最好直接附着在乐器本身。
works.technique: MIDI from the Disklavier piano drives projected graphics, and graphic events can send MIDI back to make the piano's keys move by themselves (Prix Ars Electronica Golden Nica 1997).
works.technique_zh: Disklavier 钢琴发出的 MIDI 驱动投影图形，图形事件也可以回传 MIDI，让钢琴琴键自己动起来（获 1997 年 Prix Ars Electronica 金尼卡奖）。
works.exercise_en: Track a real keyboard with image tracking and spawn AR particles above each key from Web MIDI input. Twist: let particles that fall back onto a key play that note.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一台真实键盘，通过 Web MIDI 输入在每个琴键上方生成 AR 粒子。变体：粒子落回琴键时，演奏那个音。

works.title: Kinetic Sculpture – The Shape of Things to Come
works.description: 714 metal spheres hang on thin steel wires in the BMW Museum and rise and fall together, morphing from abstract waves into the outlines of car bodies.
works.description_zh: 宝马博物馆中，714 个金属球挂在细钢丝上同步升降，从抽象的波浪逐渐变形为汽车车身的轮廓。
works.idea_en: Hundreds of points, each moving only up and down, can draw any 3D shape — the physical ancestor of AR point clouds and voxel morphs.
works.idea_zh: 数百个只会上下移动的点就能画出任何三维形状——这正是 AR 点云和体素变形的实体祖先。
works.technique: Each sphere hangs from a computer-controlled stepper motor; software samples a 3D shape at every sphere's x/y position and sets its height.
works.technique_zh: 每个金属球由一台计算机控制的步进电机吊起；软件在每个球的平面位置对三维形状取样，决定它的高度。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or AR Foundation grid of 20×20 floating spheres above a table that morph between a wave and a scanned object's height map. Twist: let the user's phone position become the peak of the wave.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上方用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 搭一个 20×20 的悬浮小球阵列，让它在波浪和一个扫描物体的高度图之间变形。变体：让用户手机的位置成为波峰。

works.title: Kinetic Rain
works.description: Two fields of 608 copper-coloured raindrops each hang over the departure hall of Changi Airport and move in a 15-minute choreography, forming wings, kites and waves.
works.description_zh: 樟宜机场出发大厅上方悬挂着两组各 608 个铜色“雨滴”，在 15 分钟的编舞中组合出机翼、风筝和波浪。
works.idea_en: A slow, synchronized swarm above people's heads turns a transit space into a place to pause — AR can use the ceiling as a stage, not just the floor.
works.idea_zh: 在人们头顶缓慢同步运动的群体把过路空间变成了驻足的地方——AR 也可以把天花板当舞台，而不只是地面。
works.technique: Each drop hangs on a thin cable from its own motor; a timeline of 3D keyframes is resampled per drop so that the grid reads as one flowing surface.
works.technique_zh: 每个雨滴由细绳挂在各自的电机上；三维关键帧动画按每个雨滴的位置重新采样，使整组看起来像一个流动的曲面。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a grid of 200 virtual raindrops to the ceiling of your classroom with plane detection and animate them into two shapes with a looping timeline. Twist: make the drops part around the viewer's head as they walk underneath.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测把 200 个虚拟雨滴锚定在教室天花板上，并用循环时间轴让它们变换出两个形状。变体：当观众走到下方时，让雨滴绕开观众的头部。

works.title: RGB|CMY Kinetic
works.description: Five motor-driven discs move through beams of red, green and blue light, and their overlapping shadows and reflections mix into cyan, magenta and yellow.
works.description_zh: 五个由电机驱动的圆盘在红、绿、蓝三色光束中移动，它们交叠的影子和反光混合成青、品红和黄色。
works.idea_en: Colour appears where light paths cross — an AR designer can design with virtual light and shadow mixing, not just with coloured objects.
works.idea_zh: 颜色出现在光路交汇之处——AR 设计者可以设计虚拟光与影的混合，而不只是给物体上色。
works.technique: Three coloured spotlights shine on reflective discs whose height and tilt are animated, so additive mixing in the reflections and subtractive mixing in the shadows change continuously.
works.technique_zh: 三盏彩色射灯照向可调高度和倾角的反光圆盘，反光中的加色混合与影子中的减色混合随之不断变化。
works.exercise_en: Place three coloured virtual lights around a real table in AR and let the user drag floating discs to see coloured shadows mix on the real surface. Twist: tie the disc heights to a music track.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中围绕真实桌面放三盏彩色虚拟灯，让用户拖动悬浮圆盘，观察真实桌面上彩色影子的混合。变体：让圆盘高度随音乐变化。

works.title: Symphonie Cinétique – The Poetry of Motion
works.description: A kinetic installation and concert in which suspended light bars and shapes rise, tilt and fall in a dark hall in step with a musical score.
works.description_zh: 一场动态装置与音乐会结合的作品：悬挂的灯条和形体在黑暗大厅中随配乐升起、倾斜、落下。
works.idea_en: Movement itself can be the melody — AR scenes feel alive when objects move in time with sound rather than simply appearing.
works.idea_zh: 运动本身就可以是旋律——当物体随声音的节奏运动而不是突然出现时，AR 场景才会显得有生命。
works.technique: Motorized winches lift and tilt light elements along precomposed trajectories that are synchronized to the musical timeline.
works.technique_zh: 电动绞盘按照预先编排的轨迹抬升和倾斜发光元素，并与音乐时间轴同步。
works.exercise_en: Choreograph five glowing bars in AR that rise and tilt to a 60-second piece of music you pick, anchored in a dark room. Twist: let a clap from the audience trigger the next movement.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗房间中用 AR 编排五根发光条，随你挑选的 60 秒音乐升起和倾斜。变体：让观众的一次拍手触发下一段动作。

works.title: Zerseher / De-viewer
works.description: A framed Renaissance painting hangs on a wall; wherever the viewer looks, an eye tracker makes that part of the picture smear and dissolve.
works.description_zh: 墙上挂着一幅文艺复兴时期的画作；观众看向哪里，眼动追踪就让画面那一处涂抹、溶解。
works.idea_en: The act of looking can destroy what you look at — gaze is a powerful and underused input for headset AR.
works.idea_zh: “看”这个动作本身就能摧毁被看的东西——注视是头显 AR 中强大却少用的输入。
works.technique: A hidden camera tracks the viewer's eyes and maps the gaze point onto the digitized painting, where a displacement brush distorts pixels over time.
works.technique_zh: 隐藏摄像头追踪观众的眼睛，把注视点映射到数字化的画作上，由位移笔刷随时间扭曲像素。
works.exercise_en: Overlay a famous painting on a real wall with a headset or HoloKit and melt the pixels where the user's head direction points. Twist: make the painting slowly heal when nobody looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 用头显或 HoloKit 把一幅名画叠加在真实墙面上，让用户头部朝向处的像素融化。变体：没人看时让画面慢慢复原。

works.title: Mobility – Reflective Kinematronic II
works.description: A grid of small mirrors on rotating arms catches a single spotlight and throws moving patterns of light onto the surrounding walls.
works.description_zh: 一组装在旋转臂上的小镜子接住一束聚光灯，把移动的光斑图案投射到周围墙面上。
works.idea_en: One light source plus many angled reflectors can write anywhere in a room — AR designers can think of reflection as a way to place content on distant surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 一个光源加上许多角度可调的反射镜，就能在房间任意位置“写字”——AR 设计者可以把反射当作把内容放到远处表面的方式。
works.technique: Each mirror's angle is computed so that its reflected spot lands on a target point on the wall; together the spots form letters or shapes.
works.technique_zh: 每面镜子的角度都经过计算，使反射光点落在墙上的目标位置，众多光点组合成文字或形状。
works.exercise_en: Cast a virtual beam from a phone-held light in AR, bounce it off virtual mirrors placed by the user, and make it land on real walls to spell a word. Twist: turn it into a two-player puzzle where each player controls half the mirrors.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从手机“光源”射出一束虚拟光，经用户摆放的虚拟镜子反射，落到真实墙面拼出一个词。变体：做成双人解谜，每人控制一半镜子。

works.title: ATOM (with Robert Henke)
works.description: An 8×8 grid of glowing helium balloons on computer-controlled winches rises and sinks above the audience, forming shapes in sync with Robert Henke's electronic music.
works.description_zh: 一个 8×8 的发光氦气球阵列挂在电脑控制的绞盘上，在观众头顶升降，与 Robert Henke 的电子音乐同步组成形状。
works.idea_en: A low-resolution grid of 64 lights is enough to make a 3D display — AR effects don't need many elements if their motion is rhythmic.
works.idea_zh: 64 个光点组成的低分辨率阵列就足以成为三维显示器——只要运动有节奏，AR 效果并不需要很多元素。
works.technique: Each balloon hangs on a DMX-controlled winch; height and LED colour are sequenced from the same timeline as the music.
works.technique_zh: 每个气球挂在 DMX 控制的绞盘上；高度和 LED 颜色与音乐由同一条时间轴编排。
works.exercise_en: Make an 8×8 grid of glowing spheres float above the floor in AR and drive their heights from the frequency bands of live microphone input. Twist: let two audience members each control one half of the grid with their phones.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让 8×8 个发光球悬浮在地面上方，用麦克风实时输入的各频段驱动它们的高度。变体：让两位观众用手机各控制半个阵列。

works.title: Lichtgrenze
works.description: For the 25th anniversary of the fall of the Berlin Wall, 8,000 glowing balloons on poles traced 15 km of the former wall through the city and were released one by one into the night sky.
works.description_zh: 为纪念柏林墙倒塌 25 周年，8000 个立在杆上的发光气球沿柏林墙旧址穿城排出 15 公里，最后被逐个放飞到夜空中。
works.idea_en: Marking a vanished boundary on the real map, then letting people release it, is location-based AR in physical form.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地图上标出一条已消失的边界，再让人们亲手把它放走——这是实体形式的地理定位 AR。
works.technique: Balloons with LEDs were mounted on stands along the surveyed wall path; volunteer 'balloon patrons' released them in sequence at a set time.
works.technique_zh: 装有 LED 的气球沿测绘好的柏林墙路线安装在支架上，由志愿“气球守护人”在指定时间依次放飞。
works.exercise_en: Plot a vanished line in your town (an old wall, river or tram track) as a row of glowing geo-anchored markers in phone AR. Twist: let each visitor release one marker so the line disappears over the day.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 把你所在城市一条消失的线（旧城墙、河道或电车轨）标成一排地理锚定的发光标记。变体：让每位访客放飞一个标记，使这条线在一天中逐渐消失。

works.title: DEEP WEB (with Robert Henke)
works.description: In a huge dark power station, 175 motorized white spheres rise and fall while laser beams hit them and draw connecting lines, forming a moving 3D web of light to a live score.
works.description_zh: 在巨大的黑暗发电厂中，175 个电动白色球体升降，激光束打在球上并连成线，随现场音乐构成不断变化的三维光网。
works.idea_en: Lines only appear when light hits an object in the air — AR can use real or virtual 'anchors' so that graphics connect points in space.
works.idea_zh: 只有当光打到空中的物体时，线条才会出现——AR 可以用真实或虚拟的“锚点”，让图形在空间中连接各个点。
works.technique: Sphere heights are driven by winches and laser projectors are calibrated to each sphere's known 3D position, so beams can jump between them.
works.technique_zh: 球的高度由绞盘控制，激光投影机按每个球的已知三维位置进行校准，使光束能在球之间跳转。
works.exercise_en: Hang a few real balls or paper lanterns, register their positions in AR, and draw animated laser-like lines between them from your phone. Twist: let the lines rewire themselves when someone walks through them.
works.exercise_zh: 挂几个真实的球或纸灯笼，在 AR 中登记它们的位置，并用手机在它们之间画出动态的“激光”连线。变体：有人穿过时让连线自动重新连接。

works.title: GRID (with Robert Henke)
works.description: Horizontal LED rods hang in a grid on winches, lifting, tilting and changing colour to Robert Henke's music, so lines of light build planes and tunnels in space.
works.description_zh: 水平的 LED 灯杆以网格悬挂在绞盘上，随 Robert Henke 的音乐升降、倾斜、变色，光线在空间中组成平面和隧道。
works.idea_en: Tilting a line of light turns it into a plane — a few controllable lines can sketch whole architectures around the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 倾斜一条光线就能得到一个平面——少量可控的线就能在观众周围勾勒出整个建筑。
works.technique: Each rod hangs from two winches, so the difference in cable length sets its tilt; motion and colour are sequenced with the music.
works.technique_zh: 每根灯杆由两个绞盘吊起，两根缆绳的长度差决定倾角；运动和颜色与音乐一起编排。
works.exercise_en: Hang ten virtual light rods from the ceiling in AR and animate their tilt to form a tunnel the viewer can walk through. Twist: bind each rod's angle to the viewer's distance from it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从天花板吊下十根虚拟灯杆，让它们倾斜形成观众可以走进去的隧道。变体：让每根灯杆的角度与观众离它的距离绑定。

works.title: SKALAR (with Kangding Ray)
works.description: Dozens of large kinetic mirrors hang in the dark Kraftwerk Berlin hall and tilt to catch beams from moving lights, bouncing them into ever-changing structures to music by Kangding Ray.
works.description_zh: 数十面大型动态镜子悬挂在柏林 Kraftwerk 的黑暗大厅中，倾斜着接住移动灯的光束并反射出不断变化的光结构，配以 Kangding Ray 的音乐。
works.idea_en: Mirrors multiply a few light sources into a whole architecture — reflective virtual surfaces can multiply the reach of AR content.
works.idea_zh: 镜子把少数光源放大成整座建筑——带反射的虚拟表面也能扩大 AR 内容的覆盖范围。
works.technique: Winch-held mirrors are tilted by motors while moving-head lights aim at them; beam paths are planned from the known mirror positions.
works.technique_zh: 由绞盘吊起的镜子被电机调整倾角，摇头灯瞄准它们；光束路径根据已知的镜面位置规划。
works.exercise_en: Place three virtual mirrors in a real room and let the user aim a beam from their phone so it bounces between them onto the real walls. Twist: make the mirrors slowly tilt by themselves so the user has to chase the beam.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间中放三面虚拟镜子，让用户从手机射出光束在镜间反射并落到真实墙上。变体：让镜子自行缓慢倾斜，用户必须追着光束调整。

works.title: Cloud
works.description: A 5-metre cloud-shaped sculpture at Heathrow Terminal 5 is covered in 4,638 flip-dots that flip between silver and black, sending ripples and patterns across its skin with a soft clicking sound.
works.description_zh: 希思罗机场 5 号航站楼中一座 5 米长的云形雕塑，表面覆盖 4638 个翻片，在银色与黑色之间翻转，发出轻微的咔嗒声，在表皮上荡起波纹和图案。
works.idea_en: A display wrapped around a sculptural form reads as a living skin — AR content feels more physical when it follows the curvature of a real object.
works.idea_zh: 包裹在雕塑形体上的显示面读起来像一层活的皮肤——当 AR 内容贴合真实物体的曲面时，会显得更有实体感。
works.technique: Electromagnetic flip-dots, each a disc with a black and a reflective side, are driven row by row so animations travel across the curved surface.
works.technique_zh: 电磁翻片一面黑、一面反光，按行驱动，使动画沿着弯曲表面流动。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real object (a chair, a sculpture) with LiDAR and cover its mesh in AR with thousands of tiny flipping tiles that ripple when you tap it. Twist: add a click sound per tile and let the ripple spread only as fast as sound would.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 扫描一个真实物体（椅子或雕塑），在 AR 中给它的网格覆盖成千上万个会翻转的小方片，点击时泛起涟漪。变体：给每片加一个咔嗒声，并让涟漪以“声音速度”缓慢扩散。

works.title: Falling Light
works.description: Light shines through slowly turning glass lenses, and the focused spots on the floor look like drops of light that fall, grow and splash across the ground.
works.description_zh: 光线穿过缓慢转动的玻璃透镜，落在地面上的聚焦光斑像一滴滴下落、扩大、溅开的光。
works.idea_en: Caustics make light look like a liquid — animated light spots on the real floor are a cheap, convincing AR effect.
works.idea_zh: 焦散让光看起来像液体——在真实地面上移动的光斑是一种便宜又逼真的 AR 效果。
works.technique: Rotating lenses shift and refocus the beams from a light source above, so bright caustic spots move and pulse on the floor below.
works.technique_zh: 旋转的透镜不断移动和重新聚焦上方光源的光束，使明亮的焦散光斑在下方地面上移动、脉动。
works.exercise_en: Project virtual caustic 'raindrops' onto a detected floor plane in AR that fall from a point above and splash into rings. Twist: let the drops fall only where nobody is standing.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中向检测到的地面平面投射虚拟焦散“雨滴”，从上方一点落下并溅成光环。变体：只让雨滴落在没人站立的地方。

works.title: Thixotropes
works.description: Hanging sculptures made of LED lines spin, and at speed the lines blur into solid-looking 3D volumes that change shape as the rotation shifts.
works.description_zh: 由 LED 线条组成的悬挂雕塑高速旋转，线条被眼睛融合成看似实心的立体形体，并随旋转变化而变形。
works.idea_en: Motion can create volume that isn't there — a single moving line in AR can suggest a full solid.
works.idea_zh: 运动可以造出并不存在的体积——AR 中一条移动的线就能暗示一个完整的实体。
works.technique: Rotating LED lines at high speed exploits persistence of vision, so the eye integrates their paths into surfaces of revolution.
works.technique_zh: 高速旋转的 LED 线条利用视觉暂留，让眼睛把它们的轨迹整合成回转曲面。
works.exercise_en: Spin a thin glowing line fast in AR with long motion trails so it sweeps out a vase-like volume above a table. Twist: let the user bend the line with a pinch gesture to reshape the volume.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让一条细细的发光线快速旋转并留下长拖尾，在桌面上方“扫”出花瓶般的体积。变体：让用户用捏合手势弯曲这条线，改变体积形状。

works.title: Dark Matter
works.description: Three black geometric objects rotate slowly; from certain angles each one looks like a perfect square or circle, then collapses into an unfamiliar shape as it turns.
works.description_zh: 三个黑色几何体缓慢旋转；在某些角度，它们看起来是完美的正方形或圆形，转动后又变成陌生的形状。
works.idea_en: A 3D object has as many identities as viewpoints — AR designers can hide a message that only resolves from one angle.
works.idea_zh: 一个三维物体有多少视角就有多少身份——AR 设计者可以藏一个只在某个角度才成立的信息。
works.technique: The objects are designed so their silhouettes are simple primitives from particular directions; rotation sweeps the viewer through these silhouettes.
works.technique_zh: 这些物体被设计成从特定方向看轮廓是简单几何形；旋转让观众依次看到这些轮廓。
works.exercise_en: Model a shape in Blender whose silhouette is a circle from the front and a square from the side, then place it in AR so visitors discover both. Twist: add a third hidden silhouette that spells a letter.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 中建一个正面轮廓是圆、侧面轮廓是方的形体，放进 AR 让观众自己发现两种样子。变体：再藏一个能拼出字母的第三种轮廓。

works.title: The Shape of a Circle in the Mind of a Square
works.description: A black rotating sculpture turns steadily and its outline switches between a circle and a square, 'squaring the circle' in front of the viewer's eyes.
works.description_zh: 一件黑色旋转雕塑匀速转动，它的轮廓在圆与方之间切换，在观众眼前“化圆为方”。
works.idea_en: Rotation reveals that circle and square can be the same object — a clear demo of why AR must be judged from many viewpoints.
works.idea_zh: 旋转揭示出圆和方可以是同一个物体——这是一个说明为什么 AR 必须从多个视角检验的清晰例子。
works.technique: The sculpture's cross-sections are shaped so that its projected silhouette morphs between a circle and a square as it rotates about one axis.
works.technique_zh: 雕塑的截面经过设计，绕一根轴旋转时，投影轮廓在圆形与方形之间变化。
works.exercise_en: Build a spinning AR object that looks like a circle to one user and a square to another standing 90° away, using shared anchors. Twist: let the users swap places and argue about what they saw.
works.exercise_zh: 用共享锚点做一个旋转的 AR 物体，让一位用户看到圆，站在 90° 外的另一位看到方。变体：让两人交换位置，讨论各自看到了什么。

works.title: Arcades
works.description: Beams of light pass through haze and lenses and appear to bend into a row of glowing arches, so light seems to curve like architecture.
works.description_zh: 光束穿过雾气和透镜，看起来弯成一排发光的拱门，仿佛光像建筑一样弯曲。
works.idea_en: Light should travel in straight lines, so when it looks curved we stop and look — AR can break physical expectations in small, elegant ways.
works.idea_zh: 光本应走直线，所以当它看起来弯曲时我们会停下来看——AR 可以用小而优雅的方式打破物理常识。
works.technique: Beams are split and redirected by lenses and mirrors so that a sequence of straight segments in haze reads as a continuous arch.
works.technique_zh: 光束被透镜和镜面分段、改向，使雾中一段段直线读起来像一道连续的拱。
works.exercise_en: Draw a row of volumetric light arches over a real hallway in AR that look like bent beams of light. Twist: let the arches straighten out when the viewer stops walking.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中在真实走廊上方画一排看起来像弯曲光束的体积光拱门。变体：观众停下脚步时，让光拱慢慢变直。

works.title: Volume
works.description: A field of 46 tall light columns in the V&A garden senses visitors walking among them and answers with waves of light and sound.
works.description_zh: 维多利亚与阿尔伯特博物馆花园里立着 46 根高大的光柱，感知在其间走动的观众，并以光与声的波动回应。
works.idea_en: People become the performers when a space answers their movement — AR in public spaces works best when crowds can 'play' it together.
works.idea_zh: 当空间回应人们的移动时，人就成了表演者——公共空间中的 AR 最好能让人群一起“演奏”。
works.technique: Infrared cameras track visitors' positions and a generative system maps proximity to the light and sound behaviour of each column.
works.technique_zh: 红外摄像头追踪观众位置，生成系统把人与每根光柱的距离映射为光和声音的变化。
works.exercise_en: Place 16 virtual light columns in a courtyard with shared AR anchors so that each one glows and hums when a participant walks close to it. Twist: make columns sing louder when two people stand near the same one.
works.exercise_zh: 用共享 AR 锚点在庭院中放 16 根虚拟光柱，参与者靠近时光柱就会发光并发出嗡鸣。变体：两个人同时靠近同一根时，让它唱得更响。

works.title: Chorus
works.description: Tall pendulums, each carrying light and a speaker, swing in and out of phase in a dark space, sweeping beams and voices across the room.
works.description_zh: 黑暗空间中，一根根高大的摆锤各自带着灯和扬声器，时而同步时而错开地摆动，让光束和人声扫过整个房间。
works.idea_en: Phase is a composition tool: identical pendulums slightly out of sync produce endless patterns — useful for any repeating AR animation.
works.idea_zh: 相位是一种作曲工具：稍微不同步的相同摆锤会产生无尽的图案——对任何循环的 AR 动画都很有用。
works.technique: Motor-driven pendulums of equal length are started with different phases and each one carries a light and a speaker, so light and sound move together.
works.technique_zh: 等长的电动摆锤以不同相位启动，每根都带着灯和扬声器，使光与声一起移动。
works.exercise_en: Hang eight virtual pendulums with spot lights and spatial audio from the ceiling in AR, each with a slightly different period. Twist: let the user nudge one pendulum by walking into its path.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从天花板挂下八根带聚光灯和空间音频的虚拟摆锤，每根周期略有不同。变体：用户走进摆动路径时，会推动其中一根。

works.title: Vanishing Point
works.description: Laser lines drawn in haze converge on a single point in the room, building and dissolving Renaissance-style perspective grids around the viewer.
works.description_zh: 在雾中画出的激光线汇聚到房间中的一个点，在观众周围搭建又消解文艺复兴式的透视网格。
works.idea_en: Perspective is a construction you can stand inside — AR designers can make the vanishing point itself a visible object.
works.idea_zh: 透视是一种可以走进去的构造——AR 设计者可以把消失点本身做成一个可见的物体。
works.technique: Lasers project lines through haze from a fixed origin so that all lines meet at a chosen vanishing point, animated to reveal and collapse the grid.
works.technique_zh: 激光从固定原点穿过雾气投射线条，所有线都汇向一个选定的消失点，并通过动画显现和收拢网格。
works.exercise_en: Draw glowing perspective lines in AR that all converge on one point in a real corridor, and let them rebuild the grid as the user walks. Twist: move the vanishing point to follow the user's head.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中画出汇聚到真实走廊中某一点的发光透视线，用户走动时让它们重新搭建网格。变体：让消失点跟随用户的头部移动。

works.title: Momentum
works.description: Twelve pendulums carrying light and sound swing along the 90-metre curved Barbican gallery, sweeping shadows and beams across visitors in the dark.
works.description_zh: 十二根带着光和声音的摆锤在巴比肯 90 米长的弧形画廊中摆动，在黑暗中让影子和光束扫过观众。
works.idea_en: Movement of light makes time tangible — you feel the rhythm of the room through shadows passing over your own body.
works.idea_zh: 光的运动让时间可以被触摸——你能通过掠过自己身体的影子感受到房间的节奏。
works.technique: Robotic pendulums follow programmed swing patterns while their lights and speakers are sequenced so beams and sounds travel along the curve.
works.technique_zh: 机械摆锤按编程的摆动模式运动，同时灯光和扬声器被编排，让光束与声音沿弧形空间移动。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual pendulum light in a dark room with AR and cast real-time shadows of the user's body onto the detected walls. Twist: let the pendulum slow down whenever the user stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗房间中用 AR 放一盏虚拟摆锤灯，把用户身体的实时影子投到检测到的墙面上。变体：用户静止时让摆锤慢下来。

works.title: Our Time
works.description: A grid of pendulums hangs from the ceiling in darkness; lights and sounds swing and change speed so the room seems to speed up, slow down and stretch time.
works.description_zh: 一组摆锤从天花板垂下；黑暗中灯光和声音摆动并改变速度，房间仿佛在加速、减速、拉伸时间。
works.idea_en: Changing the tempo of a whole space changes how long a minute feels — AR can shape subjective time, not just space.
works.idea_zh: 改变整个空间的节奏会改变一分钟的长短感——AR 可以塑造主观时间，而不只是空间。
works.technique: Motorized pendulums with lights are driven at shifting rates and phases, with sound tied to each pendulum's movement.
works.technique_zh: 带灯的电动摆锤以不断变化的速率和相位运动，声音与每根摆锤的运动绑定。
works.exercise_en: Fill a room with a grid of swinging virtual lights in AR and slowly change their tempo over three minutes, then ask participants how long they think they were inside. Twist: link the tempo to the room's noise level.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用一组摆动的虚拟灯填满房间，在三分钟内缓慢改变节奏，然后问参与者觉得自己在里面待了多久。变体：让节奏与房间的噪音大小挂钩。

works.title: New Spring (for COS)
works.description: A tall aluminium tree releases bubbles filled with white mist from its branches; visitors wearing special gloves can hold and bounce them before they burst into a puff of vapour.
works.description_zh: 一棵高大的铝制树从枝头释放充满白雾的泡泡；观众戴上特制手套就能托住、弹起它们，直到它们破裂成一缕雾气。
works.idea_en: A form that lives a few seconds and responds to your hand is irresistible — ephemeral, touchable AR objects hold attention better than permanent ones.
works.idea_zh: 一个只存在几秒、又会回应你手的形体令人无法抗拒——短暂可触的 AR 物体比永久存在的物体更能抓住注意力。
works.technique: A machine in the tree forms soap bubbles and fills them with scented mist; special fabric gloves let the bubbles bounce without popping.
works.technique_zh: 树中的机器吹出肥皂泡并充入带香味的雾气；特制的织物手套让泡泡可以弹跳而不破裂。
works.exercise_en: Make virtual mist bubbles bloom from a real plant with AR and let hand tracking bounce them until they burst into a particle puff. Twist: bubbles only survive on the palm of a user who moves very gently.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 让虚拟雾气泡从一株真实植物上绽放，借助手部追踪让它们在手上弹跳，最后破裂成一团粒子。变体：只有动作非常轻柔的用户才能让泡泡在掌心存活。

works.title: Silent Fall
works.description: In a dark gallery, a continuous fall of mist-filled bubbles drifts down onto a reflective floor and bursts into small clouds of vapour among the visitors.
works.description_zh: 在黑暗的展厅中，充满雾气的泡泡连绵不断地飘落到反光地面上，在观众之间破裂成一团团小雾。
works.idea_en: Constant gentle falling, like snow, is calming and endlessly watchable — AR ambient effects work best at slow, steady rates.
works.idea_zh: 像雪一样持续轻柔地下落让人平静、百看不厌——AR 环境效果以缓慢稳定的速度最有效。
works.technique: Machines above the room blow soap bubbles filled with mist that fall under gravity and burst on impact, releasing the vapour.
works.technique_zh: 房间上方的机器吹出充雾的肥皂泡，泡泡受重力下落，落地破裂时释放雾气。
works.exercise_en: Rain slow, glowing bubbles from the ceiling in AR that burst into mist when they hit the real floor or the user's body mesh. Twist: let the fall rate follow the room's quietness.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中从天花板落下缓慢发光的泡泡，撞到真实地面或用户身体网格时破成雾气。变体：让下落速度随房间的安静程度变化。

works.title: Slow Arc Inside a Cube IV
works.description: A robotic arm moves a single bright light slowly inside a cage cube, casting the shadow of the cage across the whole room so the walls seem to stretch and tilt.
works.description_zh: 一只机械臂在一个笼状立方体内缓慢移动一盏明亮的灯，把笼子的影子投满整个房间，墙面仿佛在伸展、倾斜。
works.idea_en: Moving one light inside a simple object turns the whole room into a moving drawing — AR shadows from virtual lights can transform real spaces.
works.idea_zh: 在一个简单物体内部移动一盏灯，就能把整个房间变成流动的图画——虚拟光源投下的 AR 影子可以改变真实空间。
works.technique: A mechanical arm traces a slow path (inspired by the motion of a molecule) with a lamp inside a lattice cube, projecting shifting perspective shadows.
works.technique_zh: 机械臂带着灯在格子立方体内沿一条缓慢轨迹（灵感来自分子运动）移动，投射出不断变化的透视阴影。
works.exercise_en: Put a virtual point light inside a virtual lattice cube in the middle of a real room and cast its shadows onto the scanned walls with AR occlusion. Twist: let the user drag the light with their hand and watch the room warp.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间中央放一个虚拟格子立方体，里面放一盏虚拟点光源，借助 AR 遮挡把阴影投到扫描过的墙面上。变体：让用户用手拖动光源，看房间扭曲。

works.title: Timepiece
works.description: In the domed Roundhouse, a huge three-armed mechanism turns like a clock with a light at its tip, sweeping shadows across the space and marking hours, minutes and seconds.
works.description_zh: 在圆顶的 Roundhouse 中，一个巨大的三臂机构像时钟一样转动，末端带着一盏灯，让影子扫过整个空间，标记时、分、秒。
works.idea_en: Turning a clock into a moving light makes time something you stand inside — AR can externalize invisible rhythms at architectural scale.
works.idea_zh: 把时钟变成一盏移动的灯，时间就成了你身处其中的东西——AR 可以把看不见的节奏放大到建筑尺度。
works.technique: Three nested rotating arms move at the rates of clock hands, carrying a lamp whose combined motion traces a complex path through the dome.
works.technique_zh: 三根嵌套旋转的手臂以时钟指针的速率运动，末端的灯在组合运动下在穹顶中描出复杂路径。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a room-sized virtual clock in AR whose three arms carry a light and cast shadows of real furniture over one class period. Twist: speed it up 60× when someone raises a hand.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中锚定一座房间大小的虚拟时钟，它的三根臂带着灯，在一节课的时间里投射出真实家具的影子。变体：有人举手时让它加速 60 倍。

works.title: The ADA Project
works.description: An industrial robot named ADA holds a light at the end of its arm and 'dances' to pieces by different composers, drawing arcs of light in a dark room.
works.description_zh: 一台名为 ADA 的工业机械臂末端握着一盏灯，随不同作曲家的作品“起舞”，在黑暗房间中画出光弧。
works.idea_en: A robot becomes a dancer when its motion follows music — AR characters don't need faces, only well-timed movement.
works.idea_zh: 当机械臂的运动跟随音乐时，它就成了舞者——AR 角色不需要脸，只需要恰到好处的运动。
works.technique: A six-axis industrial robot is programmed with motion paths synchronized to each commissioned score, with a lamp as its end effector.
works.technique_zh: 六轴工业机器人被编入与每首委约乐曲同步的运动路径，末端装着一盏灯。
works.exercise_en: Program a virtual robotic arm in AR with a light at its tip to dance to a 30-second track, and record its light trails as a long exposure. Twist: let a classmate compose the music and swap tracks without changing the motion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中编程一只末端带灯的虚拟机械臂，随 30 秒音乐起舞，并把光轨录成长曝光。变体：让同学作曲，在不改动作的情况下换曲，看感受如何变化。

works.title: The Dappled Light of the Sun
works.description: A cloud-like canopy of thousands of steel tetrahedra hovers above visitors' heads outdoors, breaking sunlight into dappled patches like a tree canopy.
works.description_zh: 一片由成千上万个钢制四面体组成、如云般的顶棚悬浮在户外观众头顶，把阳光打碎成树荫般的斑驳光影。
works.idea_en: A structure overhead can shape the light you walk through — outdoor AR can use the sky and sun as part of the composition.
works.idea_zh: 头顶的结构可以塑造你穿行其中的光——户外 AR 可以把天空与太阳当作构图的一部分。
works.technique: Tetrahedra of weathering steel are assembled in a branching, cloud-like mass on a few supports, letting sunlight filter through the gaps.
works.technique_zh: 耐候钢四面体以分支状、云团般的方式组装在少数支撑上，让阳光从缝隙中透下。
works.exercise_en: Float a canopy of virtual tetrahedra above an outdoor plaza in phone AR and cast shadows that match the real sun direction. Twist: make the canopy slowly grow new branches each time a visitor looks up.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外广场上方用手机 AR 悬浮一片虚拟四面体顶棚，并投下与真实太阳方向一致的影子。变体：每当有访客抬头，顶棚就慢慢长出新的枝杈。

works.title: Optic Cloak
works.description: A 49-metre energy-centre flue in Greenwich is wrapped in faceted, perforated panels whose overlapping holes create shimmering moiré patterns that make the tower's outline dissolve.
works.description_zh: 伦敦格林尼治一座 49 米高的能源中心烟囱被包裹在多面穿孔板中，重叠的孔洞产生闪烁的莫尔纹，使塔身轮廓溶解。
works.idea_en: Camouflage can be dynamic: patterns that shift with your movement make a solid building look immaterial — a lesson for diminished-reality AR.
works.idea_zh: 迷彩可以是动态的：随你移动而变化的图案能让实体建筑看起来虚无——这是削弱现实（diminished reality）AR 的一课。
works.technique: Two layers of perforated triangular panels overlap at an offset so that parallax creates moiré interference as the viewer moves, inspired by dazzle camouflage.
works.technique_zh: 两层穿孔三角板错位重叠，观众移动时视差产生莫尔干涉，灵感来自一战的炫目迷彩。
works.exercise_en: Wrap a real pillar or building in AR with two layers of virtual perforated patterns that shimmer with the user's movement. Twist: tune the patterns so the object seems to disappear from one sweet spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中给一根真实柱子或建筑包上两层虚拟穿孔图案，让它们随用户移动而闪烁。变体：调整图案，使物体从某个最佳位置看去仿佛消失。

works.title: Liminal Air Space-Time
works.description: A vast sheet of thin fabric floats and ripples above visitors in a large hall, lifted by fans so it rises, sinks and breathes like a living surface.
works.description_zh: 一大片极薄的布料在一座大厅中漂浮于观众头顶，被风扇托起，起伏、下沉，如同会呼吸的活表面。
works.idea_en: Air is invisible until something shows it — AR can visualize flow, wind and breath through a single responsive surface.
works.idea_zh: 空气在被某种东西显现之前是看不见的——AR 可以用一张会响应的表面来可视化气流、风和呼吸。
works.technique: Fans placed around the space create controlled air currents that keep a large, very light fabric sheet aloft and moving in slow waves.
works.technique_zh: 场地四周的风扇产生受控气流，让一大片极轻的布料悬浮在空中并缓慢起伏。
works.exercise_en: Simulate a giant cloth floating above the floor in AR that billows when the user blows into the phone microphone. Twist: let several phones in the room each act as a 'fan' from different directions.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中模拟一块漂浮在地面上方的巨大布料，用户对着手机麦克风吹气时布料鼓起。变体：让房间里的几部手机分别从不同方向充当“风扇”。

works.title: Memorial Rebirth
works.description: Dozens of machines release a flood of soap bubbles over a neighbourhood street or park, turning an ordinary place into a shared, fleeting celebration.
works.description_zh: 数十台机器向街区道路或公园放出如潮的肥皂泡，把平凡的地方变成一场共享而短暂的庆典。
works.idea_en: Something that fills the air and vanishes brings strangers together — ephemeral, city-scale AR events can do the same.
works.idea_zh: 充满空气又转瞬消失的东西能把陌生人聚到一起——短暂的城市尺度 AR 活动也能做到这一点。
works.technique: Arrays of bubble machines are placed around a site and run in sequence so that waves of bubbles drift with the wind across the crowd.
works.technique_zh: 成组的泡泡机布置在场地四周并依次运行，让一波波泡泡随风飘过人群。
works.exercise_en: Launch a shared AR bubble storm in a park where every participant's phone releases bubbles that everyone else can see and pop. Twist: popped bubbles leave a short sound so the park 'rings'.
works.exercise_zh: 在公园里发起一场共享 AR 泡泡风暴，每位参与者的手机都会放出所有人都能看见、戳破的泡泡。变体：泡泡破裂时发出短促声响，让整个公园“叮当”作响。

works.title: Gravity and Grace
works.description: A huge perforated metal vase with an intense light inside slowly rises and falls in a dark room, throwing patterns of flowers and figures across the walls, floor and visitors.
works.description_zh: 一只巨大的镂空金属花瓶内有强光，在黑暗房间中缓慢升降，把花朵与人物的图案投满墙面、地面和观众身上。
works.idea_en: A single light inside a patterned shell can fill every surface of a room, including people — AR light projection should land on bodies too.
works.idea_zh: 镂空外壳里的一盏灯就能照满房间的每个表面，包括人身——AR 光投射也应该落在身体上。
works.technique: An extremely bright lamp inside a pierced metal vessel acts as a pattern projector; moving the light vertically changes the scale of the shadows.
works.technique_zh: 镂空金属容器里的高亮灯充当图案投影器；灯的上下移动改变阴影的尺度。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual lantern with a cut-out pattern in the centre of a real room and project its light patterns onto walls and people using body segmentation. Twist: let the lantern pattern change based on who stands closest.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间中央放一盏带镂空图案的虚拟灯笼，借助人体分割把光斑图案投到墙面和人身上。变体：根据谁站得最近来改变灯笼的图案。

works.title: ClockClock
works.description: Twenty-four analogue clocks arranged in a grid rotate their hands in choreographed sweeps, then stop so that the hands together form the digits of the current time.
works.description_zh: 二十四个模拟时钟排成网格，指针按编排整齐旋转，然后停下来，所有指针合起来拼出当前时间的数字。
works.idea_en: A familiar object used in an unfamiliar grid becomes a new display — AR can recombine everyday objects as pixels.
works.idea_zh: 把熟悉的物件放进陌生的阵列里，它就成了一种新的显示器——AR 可以把日常物件重新组合成像素。
works.technique: Each clock has two independently driven hands on stepper motors; firmware animates transitions and then aligns hand angles into segment-style digits.
works.technique_zh: 每个时钟有两根由步进电机独立驱动的指针；固件先做过渡动画，再把指针角度对齐成类似数码管的数字。
works.exercise_en: Build a 6×4 grid of virtual clock faces on a real wall in AR whose hands swirl and then spell the current time or the user's initials. Twist: let the hands point at the viewer as they walk past.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中于真实墙面上做一个 6×4 的虚拟钟面阵列，指针旋转后拼出当前时间或用户姓名首字母。变体：观众走过时让所有指针指向他。

works.title: A Million Times
works.description: A large wall of analogue clocks turns its hands into flowing patterns of waves, spirals and flocks before settling to show the time.
works.description_zh: 一面由大量模拟时钟组成的墙，让指针汇成波浪、漩涡和鸟群般流动的图案，最后停下来显示时间。
works.idea_en: Many identical rotating parts can move like a flock — emergent patterns from simple rules are an efficient way to animate AR grids.
works.idea_zh: 许多相同的旋转部件能像鸟群一样运动——由简单规则产生的涌现图案是驱动 AR 阵列动画的高效方法。
works.technique: Clock hands are driven individually and animated as a vector field sampled at each clock position, so the whole grid reads as flowing motion.
works.technique_zh: 每根指针单独驱动，动画以向量场的形式在每个时钟位置采样，使整个阵列看起来像流动的运动。
works.exercise_en: Animate a grid of virtual clock hands in AR as a vector field that flows around the user's hand position. Twist: stop the flow and spell the time whenever the user holds still for three seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一组虚拟时钟指针做成向量场，让它们绕着用户手的位置流动。变体：用户保持不动三秒时，让流动停下并拼出时间。

works.title: A Million Times at Changi
works.description: A monumental wall of 1,008 clocks in Singapore Changi Airport performs choreographed patterns and time displays for passing travellers.
works.description_zh: 新加坡樟宜机场一面由 1008 个时钟组成的巨墙，为往来旅客表演编排好的图案并显示时间。
works.idea_en: Scale turns a clock into architecture — the same grid logic works on a phone screen or a building-sized AR overlay.
works.idea_zh: 尺度能把时钟变成建筑——同样的阵列逻辑既适用于手机屏幕，也适用于建筑尺度的 AR 叠加。
works.technique: Over a thousand clock modules with two motors each are networked and driven by a central choreography engine.
works.technique_zh: 一千多个时钟模块、每个带两台电机，联网后由中央编舞引擎驱动。
works.exercise_en: Cover a building facade in phone AR with a huge grid of clocks that ripple when a person enters the frame. Twist: show each traveller's home time zone when they point the phone at themselves.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在一栋建筑立面上覆盖一大片时钟阵列，有人进入画面时泛起涟漪。变体：当旅客把手机对准自己时，显示他家乡的时区时间。

works.title: Sweepers' Clock
works.description: Two street sweepers push lines of rubbish across the floor for twelve hours, constantly re-forming the hour and minute hands of a clock in real time.
works.description_zh: 两位清洁工连续 12 小时推动地上的两排垃圾，实时不断地重组出时钟的时针和分针。
works.idea_en: Time shown by a human performance feels warm and absurd — AR clocks, timers and progress bars could be performed rather than drawn.
works.idea_zh: 由真人表演显示的时间显得温暖又荒诞——AR 中的时钟、计时器和进度条也可以被“表演”，而不是被画出来。
works.technique: A continuous 12-hour video is filmed in one take per segment and played back in sync with the real time of day.
works.technique_zh: 拍摄一段连续 12 小时的视频，并与一天中的真实时间同步播放。
works.exercise_en: Record a volumetric or green-screen clip of yourself moving two objects as clock hands for one minute, and play it in AR on a real table in sync with the clock. Twist: let the performer react when the user taps the table.
works.exercise_zh: 录一段自己把两个物体当作钟针移动一分钟的体积视频或绿幕视频，在 AR 中与真实时间同步地放在桌面上播放。变体：用户敲桌子时让表演者做出反应。

works.title: Grandfather Clock (Real Time)
works.description: A grandfather clock whose face is a screen showing a man inside who erases and redraws the hands with a marker every minute, as if he lived inside the clock.
works.description_zh: 一座落地大摆钟的钟面是一块屏幕，里面的人每分钟用马克笔擦掉并重画指针，好像他住在钟里一样。
works.idea_en: A screen inside a familiar object makes it feel inhabited — AR can place 'someone inside' everyday objects.
works.idea_zh: 在熟悉的物件里放一块屏幕，它就像有人住在里面——AR 可以让日常物件里“住进一个人”。
works.technique: A 12-hour video of the performer drawing the hands behind glass is played on a display hidden in a traditional clock case, synced to the real time.
works.technique_zh: 把表演者在玻璃后画指针的 12 小时视频放在传统钟壳里的隐藏屏幕上，并与真实时间同步。
works.exercise_en: Track a real picture frame or box with image tracking and play a short loop of a tiny person living inside it. Twist: the tiny person notices the viewer and waves.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一个真实的相框或盒子，在里面循环播放一个小人在其中生活的短片。变体：小人发现观众后向他挥手。

works.title: Schiphol Clock
works.description: A huge clock at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport appears to hold a man in overalls who paints and wipes the clock hands from inside, minute by minute, all day.
works.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场的一座巨型钟里仿佛有一个穿工装的人，整天一分钟一分钟地从里面画上又擦去指针。
works.idea_en: An endless small human task in a public place gives travellers a moment of empathy — AR in transit spaces can use tiny human stories.
works.idea_zh: 公共场所里一个永无止境的小小人类劳作，能让旅客产生片刻共情——交通空间中的 AR 可以运用微小的人物故事。
works.technique: A 12-hour video recorded in real time is shown on a screen inside a transparent clock housing, synced to local time.
works.technique_zh: 实时录制的 12 小时视频在透明钟壳内的屏幕上播放，并与当地时间同步。
works.exercise_en: Create a location-anchored AR clock at your school entrance where a recorded classmate 'paints' the time every minute. Twist: swap the performer each hour so a different student lives in the clock.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校入口创建一个位置锚定的 AR 时钟，由一位同学的录像每分钟“画出”时间。变体：每小时换一位表演者，让不同的同学住在钟里。

works.title: Schiphol People's Clock
works.description: A new clock at Schiphol in which the hands are formed by many different people, one after another, so the time is shown by a changing crowd of performers.
works.description_zh: 史基浦机场的一座新钟，指针由许多不同的人轮流组成，时间由一群不断更换的表演者来显示。
works.idea_en: Letting many people 'be' the interface makes it communal — AR experiences can be built from crowd-contributed recordings.
works.idea_zh: 让许多人“成为”界面，界面就有了集体感——AR 体验可以由众人贡献的录像组成。
works.technique: Likely a sequence of recorded clips of many participants posing as hands, edited and played back in sync with real time.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把众多参与者扮演指针的录像片段剪辑在一起，并与真实时间同步播放。
works.exercise_en: Collect short phone videos of classmates posing as clock hands and assemble them into an AR clock that plays each clip at the matching minute. Twist: let visitors record themselves and join the clock.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同学们扮演钟针的手机短视频，把它们组合成一个 AR 时钟，在对应的分钟播放各自的片段。变体：让访客录下自己并加入这座钟。

works.title: Hyper-Matrix (Hyundai Motor Group Pavilion, Expo 2012 Yeosu)
works.description: A giant wall made of thousands of white cubes pushed in and out by motors forms waves, faces and 3D patterns, with projected light enhancing the relief.
works.description_zh: 由数千个被电机推进推出的白色方块组成的巨墙，形成波浪、人脸和立体图案，投影光进一步增强浮雕效果。
works.idea_en: A wall that physically moves is shocking because walls never move — AR can make solid architecture appear to breathe.
works.idea_zh: 会动的墙令人震撼，因为墙从来不动——AR 可以让坚实的建筑看起来在呼吸。
works.technique: Each cube is likely mounted on a stepper-driven rod; a height-map animation is sent to the actuator grid and synchronized with projection.
works.technique_zh: 每个方块很可能装在步进电机驱动的推杆上；高度图动画被发送到执行器阵列，并与投影同步。
works.exercise_en: Replace a real wall in AR with a grid of cubes that push out to form the silhouette of whoever stands in front of it. Twist: use depth from the LiDAR to make the relief follow the user's body.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一面真实的墙替换成方块阵列，方块推出后形成站在它面前的人的轮廓。变体：用 LiDAR 深度让浮雕跟随用户的身体。

works.title: Echo (Flip-Discs)
works.description: A wall of flip-discs clatters to mirror the silhouette of a person moving in front of it, leaving a fading echo of their motion.
works.description_zh: 一面翻片墙哗啦作响地映出面前移动之人的剪影，并留下他们动作逐渐消散的“回声”。
works.idea_en: A low-resolution mirror with sound is more magical than a perfect one — AR body effects can be coarse if they are tactile and audible.
works.idea_zh: 带声音的低分辨率镜子比完美的镜子更有魔力——只要有触感和声响，AR 身体效果可以很粗糙。
works.technique: A camera or depth sensor segments the viewer; the silhouette is downsampled to the flip-disc grid, with a decay so past frames linger.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头或深度传感器分割出观众，剪影被降采样到翻片网格上，并加入衰减让之前的帧残留一会儿。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or AR Foundation effect that turns the camera's person segmentation into a grid of flipping discs with a click sound per flip. Twist: make the discs lag behind so users see their own recent past.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 做一个效果，把摄像头的人像分割变成一格格翻转的圆片，每翻一片发出一声咔嗒。变体：让圆片延迟翻转，用户能看见自己刚才的样子。

works.title: Brixel Mirror
works.description: Hundreds of mirrored rotating bricks turn to reflect or hide light, forming a moving image of the viewer standing in front.
works.description_zh: 数百块镜面旋转砖块转动，反射或遮蔽光线，拼出站在面前的观众的动态影像。
works.idea_en: A mirror made of real mirrors, each one choosing where to reflect, blends physical and computed reflection — like AR on a real surface.
works.idea_zh: 由真实镜子组成、每块都在“选择”反射方向的镜子，把物理反射与计算结合起来——就像在真实表面上的 AR。
works.technique: Each Brixel is a motor-driven rotating element with mirrored faces; the camera image is mapped to rotation angles per brick.
works.technique_zh: 每个 Brixel 都是一块由电机驱动、带镜面的旋转单元；摄像头图像被映射为每块砖的旋转角度。
works.exercise_en: Overlay a grid of virtual mirrored tiles on a real wall in AR that turn to reflect the environment map where the viewer's body is. Twist: let each tile hold the reflection of a different moment in time.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中于真实墙面上叠加一组虚拟镜面瓦片，在观众身体所在处转动以反射环境贴图。变体：让每块瓦片映出不同时刻的画面。

works.title: World Skies
works.description: A flip-disc artwork that animates the colour and motion of skies from cities around the world, updating from live data.
works.description_zh: 一件翻片作品，根据实时数据呈现世界各城市天空的颜色与流动。
works.idea_en: Bringing a faraway sky into a room creates a window, not a screen — AR portals can use live data from real places.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的天空带进房间，得到的是一扇窗而不是一块屏——AR 传送门可以使用来自真实地点的实时数据。
works.technique: Likely live weather and sky imagery from multiple cities are processed into patterns rendered on a large flip-disc display.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是将多个城市的实时天气与天空图像处理成图案，再渲染到大型翻片显示屏上。
works.exercise_en: Open an AR window on your wall that shows the live sky of a city chosen by the user, using a weather API for cloud cover and time of day. Twist: the window slowly turns to a different city each time someone walks past.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上打开一扇 AR 窗户，利用天气 API 的云量和时间数据显示用户所选城市的实时天空。变体：每当有人经过，窗户慢慢切换到另一座城市。

works.title: One Hundred and Eight
works.description: A wall of 108 plastic bags inflates and deflates in rolling waves; when a viewer approaches, the bags near them pull back as if breathing away.
works.description_zh: 由 108 个塑料袋组成的墙随波浪般的节奏充气、放气；观众靠近时，附近的袋子会像呼吸一样退缩。
works.idea_en: Cheap, soft material with good timing feels alive — AR effects gain life from rhythm and reaction, not detail.
works.idea_zh: 廉价柔软的材料配上好的节奏就会显得有生命——AR 效果的生命感来自节奏与反应，而不是细节。
works.technique: Each bag is inflated by a small fan controlled by a microcontroller; a camera detects the viewer and triggers local deflation waves.
works.technique_zh: 每个袋子由微控制器控制的小风扇充气；摄像头检测到观众后触发局部的放气波。
works.exercise_en: Cover a real wall in AR with a grid of soft virtual balloons that breathe in a wave and shrink away from the user's hand. Twist: make them breathe in sync with the user's own breathing picked up by the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中给真实墙面铺上一格格柔软的虚拟气囊，随波浪呼吸，并在用户的手靠近时收缩。变体：借助麦克风让它们与用户自己的呼吸同步。

works.title: Thirty Six
works.description: Thirty-six silver bags on a wall swell and collapse in computed sequences, creating ripples that travel across the grid.
works.description_zh: 墙上三十六个银色袋子按计算好的顺序膨胀、瘪下，形成在网格上传递的涟漪。
works.idea_en: A tiny grid is enough to read waves — sequencing matters more than resolution when designing AR motion.
works.idea_zh: 很小的网格就足以读出波浪——设计 AR 动效时，编排顺序比分辨率更重要。
works.technique: Fans driven by a microcontroller inflate each bag according to a pre-programmed wave pattern with phase offsets per position.
works.technique_zh: 由微控制器驱动的风扇根据预编程的波形为每个袋子充气，不同位置带有相位差。
works.exercise_en: Animate a 6×6 grid of inflatable virtual cushions on a table in AR using a ripple function with phase offsets. Twist: let the user tap one cushion to start a new ripple from there.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用带相位差的涟漪函数驱动桌面上 6×6 个可充气的虚拟软垫。变体：用户点击某个软垫时，从那里发起新的涟漪。

works.title: Sixty Eight
works.description: A large installation of 68 inflatable elements rises and falls in slow waves across a wall, like a surface breathing.
works.description_zh: 一件由 68 个充气单元组成的大型装置在墙面上以缓慢的波浪起伏，像一张会呼吸的表面。
works.idea_en: Slow, organic motion on a hard surface makes architecture feel alive — AR can animate walls with subtle breathing instead of loud effects.
works.idea_zh: 坚硬表面上缓慢而有机的运动让建筑显得有生命——AR 可以用轻微的呼吸感而不是夸张效果来驱动墙面。
works.technique: Individually controlled fans inflate and deflate each element following layered wave functions.
works.technique_zh: 单独控制的风扇按照叠加的波函数为每个单元充气、放气。
works.exercise_en: Make a real wall 'breathe' in AR with a displacement shader driven by overlapping sine waves. Twist: slow the breathing down as the room gets quieter.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用多层正弦波驱动的位移着色器让一面真实的墙“呼吸”。变体：房间越安静，呼吸越慢。

works.title: Variations on Pi (Light Drawing Machine)
works.description: A small machine moves a light along paths computed from the digits of pi, and long exposures turn its motion into glowing drawings.
works.description_zh: 一台小机器按圆周率的数字计算出的路径移动一盏灯，长曝光把它的运动变成发光的图画。
works.idea_en: A number sequence becomes a visible trace when motion is recorded over time — AR trails can reveal data as drawings.
works.idea_zh: 当运动被随时间记录下来时，一串数字就变成了可见的轨迹——AR 拖尾可以把数据显现为图画。
works.technique: A pen-plotter-like mechanism steers an LED along paths generated from successive digits of pi, photographed with long exposure.
works.technique_zh: 一个类似绘图仪的机构按圆周率的连续数字生成的路径移动 LED，并用长曝光拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Program a virtual light point in AR that moves along a path generated from the digits of pi or a friend's phone number and leaves a permanent glowing trail. Twist: two sequences draw at once and their lines interfere.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中编程一个虚拟光点，沿着由圆周率或朋友电话号码生成的路径移动，并留下永久的发光轨迹。变体：两串数字同时作画，线条相互交织。

works.title: Temporary Printing Machine
works.description: A moving head of UV lights passes over a glow-in-the-dark surface and 'prints' images and text in light, which slowly fade away.
works.description_zh: 一排移动的紫外灯扫过夜光表面，用光“印”出图像和文字，随后慢慢褪去。
works.idea_en: An image that fades invites people to make more — temporary AR marks are playful because they do not last.
works.idea_zh: 会褪去的图像会邀请人们不断再画——临时的 AR 痕迹之所以有趣，正是因为它们不会持久。
works.technique: A row of UV LEDs is scanned across a phosphorescent surface and switched per pixel, so the charged pigment glows and fades over minutes.
works.technique_zh: 一排紫外 LED 扫过磷光表面并逐像素开关，被激发的颜料发光并在几分钟内褪去。
works.exercise_en: Let users 'print' glowing words onto a real wall in AR by sweeping their phone across it, with the marks fading over two minutes. Twist: a mark only stays if a second person sweeps over it again.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户在 AR 中用手机扫过真实墙面来“印”出发光文字，这些痕迹在两分钟内褪去。变体：只有另一个人再扫一遍，痕迹才会保留。

works.title: Swarm Light
works.description: Three cubes of hanging LEDs show points of light moving like a flock of birds, reacting to the sound of people in the room.
works.description_zh: 三个由悬挂 LED 组成的立方体中，光点像鸟群一样移动，并对房间里人的声音作出反应。
works.idea_en: A swarm drawn in real 3D pixels feels alive in a way a screen never does — AR flocks placed in real space inherit this power.
works.idea_zh: 用真实三维像素画出的群体，有屏幕永远没有的生命感——放在真实空间里的 AR 鸟群也继承了这种力量。
works.technique: A 3D grid of LEDs displays a flocking simulation; microphones in the room modulate the swarm's behaviour.
works.technique_zh: 三维 LED 阵列显示群集模拟；房间里的麦克风调节群体的行为。
works.exercise_en: Place a flock of 300 glowing points inside a wireframe cube on a real table in AR using a boids simulation, and scatter them when the microphone hears a loud sound. Twist: make the flock slowly follow whoever is quietest.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用 boids 群集模拟，在真实桌面上的线框立方体里放 300 个发光点，麦克风听到大声时让它们四散。变体：让鸟群慢慢跟随最安静的人。

works.title: Study of Time
works.description: A hanging grid of LEDs displays the passing of time as a moving shadow of light that travels across it like the hand of a clock.
works.description_zh: 一块悬挂的 LED 网格以一道移动的光影显示时间的流逝，像钟针一样扫过网格。
works.idea_en: Time can be felt as a moving light rather than read as numbers — AR clocks can be ambient instead of literal.
works.idea_zh: 时间可以被感受为移动的光，而不是被读成数字——AR 时钟可以是氛围性的，而不是字面的。
works.technique: A grid of LEDs is driven by a clock routine that sweeps illumination and shadow across the surface as the hours pass.
works.technique_zh: LED 网格由时钟程序驱动，随着时间推移让光与影扫过表面。
works.exercise_en: Hang a virtual light panel over a real doorway in AR where a band of light sweeps across it once per minute. Twist: the sweep speed follows how many people walked through the door in the last hour.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中于真实门口上方挂一块虚拟光板，每分钟有一道光带扫过。变体：扫动速度随过去一小时穿过这扇门的人数变化。

works.title: Study for Fifteen Points
works.description: Fifteen points of light on moving rods walk in the dark; with only these dots, the viewer sees a human figure walking.
works.description_zh: 十五个安装在移动杆上的光点在黑暗中行走；仅凭这些点，观众就能看到一个人在走路。
works.idea_en: The brain needs only 15 moving points to see a person (biological motion) — AR characters can be radically minimal.
works.idea_zh: 大脑只需要 15 个移动的点就能看出一个人（生物运动知觉）——AR 角色可以极度简化。
works.technique: Motion-capture data of a walking person drives 15 mechanical arms that move LED points through the recorded joint positions.
works.technique_zh: 一个行走之人的动作捕捉数据驱动 15 根机械杆，把 LED 光点移动到记录下的关节位置。
works.exercise_en: Place 15 glowing dots in AR driven by a motion-capture walk cycle and let viewers guess the gender, mood or age of the walker. Twist: record your own walk with body tracking and see if classmates can recognise you.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放 15 个由动捕行走循环驱动的发光点，让观众猜走路者的性别、情绪或年龄。变体：用身体追踪录下你自己的走路，看同学能否认出你。

works.title: Swarm Study / VII
works.description: A grid of brass rods tipped with lights shows glowing points moving through the structure like a school of fish or flock of birds.
works.description_zh: 由顶端带灯的黄铜杆组成的网格中，光点像鱼群或鸟群一样在结构里游走。
works.idea_en: Collective motion reads as life at any scale — a few hundred AR particles following flocking rules can feel like creatures.
works.idea_zh: 集体运动在任何尺度都读作生命——几百个遵循群集规则的 AR 粒子就能像生物一样。
works.technique: An array of individually addressable LEDs on rods renders a real-time swarm simulation in three dimensions.
works.technique_zh: 安装在杆上、可单独寻址的 LED 阵列以三维方式渲染实时群集模拟。
works.exercise_en: Build a sparse 3D grid of glowing rod tips in AR and render a flocking swarm through it so points only light up where a rod exists. Twist: let the swarm avoid the viewer's phone like fish avoiding a hand.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中搭一个稀疏的三维发光杆端阵列，让群集只在有杆的位置点亮来呈现鸟群。变体：让群体像鱼躲手一样躲开观众的手机。

works.title: Waves
works.description: A long rope spun by motors at both ends hangs in a dark room; when nobody is there it is a still line, and as more people move in front of it, it whips into waves and chaotic shapes that also hum as they cut the air.
works.description_zh: 一根长绳两端由电机带动旋转，悬在暗室里；没人时它是一条静止的直线，观众越多、动得越多，它就甩成波浪和混乱的形状，划破空气时还会发出嗡嗡声。
works.idea_en: One line that goes from calm to chaos as a crowd grows teaches an AR designer to map audience activity to a single, readable visual parameter.
works.idea_zh: 一条随人群增多从平静变为混乱的线，提醒 AR 设计者：把观众活动映射到一个单一、易读的视觉参数上。
works.technique: Cameras measure how much motion is in front of the piece and set the speed of two motors that rotate a rope; the rope's standing-wave shape and sound follow from physics, not from rendered graphics.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头测量作品前方的运动量，据此控制两端电机的转速；绳子的驻波形状和声音由物理本身产生，而不是渲染出来的图像。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR scene with one glowing line strung between two anchors in the room, and drive its wave amplitude and frequency from the phone camera's frame-difference motion score. Twist: add a second person's phone and let the line only go wild when both people move at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 中在房间里两个锚点之间拉一条发光的线，用手机摄像头的帧差运动量来控制它的波幅和频率。变体：加入第二个人的手机，只有两人同时动起来时线才会狂舞。

works.title: Whatever happened, Happened
works.description: A machine slowly engraves concentric growth rings into a slice of virgin wood with a laser, so the viewer watches years of tree growth being written as a physical record.
works.description_zh: 一台机器用激光在一片原木切面上慢慢刻出同心的年轮，观众看着多年的树木生长被写成实物记录。
works.idea_en: Change we never see happen can be made visible by drawing its trace step by step — AR can do the same by recording and replaying slow processes where they happened.
works.idea_zh: 我们从未亲眼看到发生的变化，可以通过一步步画出它的痕迹来显形——AR 也可以在原地记录并回放缓慢的过程。
works.technique: A laser engraver is driven by a growth model that adds one ring at a time to the wood surface, so the image accumulates physically instead of being shown as a finished graphic.
works.technique_zh: 激光雕刻机由一个生长模型驱动，每次在木头表面加刻一圈年轮，图像是物理地累积出来的，而不是一张完成的图。
works.exercise_en: Record a plant, a shadow or a pile of objects with a phone every few minutes for an hour, then place the stacked outlines as rings around the real object in AR. Twist: let viewers scrub time by walking closer or farther away.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机每隔几分钟拍一次植物、影子或一堆物品，持续一小时，然后在 AR 中把叠加的轮廓作为“年轮”环绕在真实物体周围。变体：让观众通过走近或走远来拖动时间。

works.title: tele-present wind
works.description: A dried plant stalk outdoors sways in the wind, and 42 stalks mounted on tilting robots inside the gallery sway in exact unison with it in real time.
works.description_zh: 室外一根干枯的植物茎在风中摇摆，展厅里装在倾斜机构上的 42 根茎同步地实时跟着摇动。
works.idea_en: Invisible wind from somewhere else becomes visible indoors by copying its motion onto many objects — a model for AR scenes driven by live remote data.
works.idea_zh: 把别处看不见的风的运动复制到许多物体上，它就在室内显形了——这是用远程实时数据驱动 AR 场景的范例。
works.technique: An accelerometer on the outdoor stalk streams x/y tilt to an array of servo-driven gimbals, each holding a real stalk, so the gallery field mirrors the wind with a small network delay.
works.technique_zh: 室外茎上的加速度计把 x/y 倾斜数据实时传给一组舵机云台，每个云台夹着一根真茎，于是展厅里的“草地”以很小的网络延迟镜像外面的风。
works.exercise_en: Stream a phone's accelerometer from a window ledge to a second phone that shows a field of virtual grass in AR, all bending with the real wind. Twist: route the data from a friend's city so the room shows someone else's weather.
works.exercise_zh: 把放在窗台上的手机的加速度计数据传到另一台手机，在 AR 中显示一片虚拟草地，所有草都随真实的风弯曲。变体：改用朋友所在城市的数据，让房间显示别处的天气。

works.title: tele-present water
works.description: A large grid of wooden and wire segments hangs from motors and heaves up and down like the surface of a lake, replaying wave data recorded by a buoy on Lake Superior.
works.description_zh: 一张由木段和金属丝组成的大网格挂在电机下，像湖面一样起伏，重现苏必利尔湖上浮标记录的波浪数据。
works.idea_en: A remote sea can be rebuilt as a physical mesh in a room; AR can do the same with a virtual surface anchored to the floor.
works.idea_zh: 远方的海可以在房间里重建成一张实体网格；AR 也可以把一张虚拟水面锚定在地板上做同样的事。
works.technique: Wave intensity and acceleration from a buoy are scaled and sent to a row of motors on a ceiling grid that lift and drop the mesh points, turning a data stream into a moving topography.
works.technique_zh: 浮标的波浪强度和加速度数据经缩放后传给天花板网格上的一排电机，由它们提拉和放下网格节点，把数据流变成会动的地形。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a wire-mesh plane on the classroom floor in AR and animate its vertices from a public ocean-buoy data feed or a recorded CSV. Twist: let viewers stand under it and see the mesh from below like being underwater.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一张线框网格平面锚定在教室地面上，用公开的海洋浮标数据或录好的 CSV 驱动顶点起伏。变体：让观众站到网格下方，从下往上看，好像在水下。

works.title: growth modeling device
works.description: Every 24 hours a laser scans an onion plant and a 3D printer builds a plastic model of it, then a conveyor moves on, leaving a row of models that record the plant's growth.
works.description_zh: 每 24 小时，激光扫描一次洋葱植株，3D 打印机据此打印一个塑料模型，传送带随后前移，留下一排记录植物生长的模型。
works.idea_en: Sampling a living thing at intervals and freezing each sample in space turns time into a line of objects — the core of any AR time-lapse trail.
works.idea_zh: 定时采样一个活物并把每次采样凝固在空间里，时间就变成了一排物体——这是所有 AR 延时轨迹的核心。
works.technique: A laser line scanner captures the plant from one of three angles each day and a fused-deposition 3D printer outputs the mesh in real time, after which a conveyor advances about 17 inches.
works.technique_zh: 激光线扫描仪每天从三个角度之一扫描植物，熔融沉积 3D 打印机实时输出网格，之后传送带前进约 17 英寸。
works.exercise_en: Scan a plant, a sleeping pet or a growing pile of dishes with a LiDAR phone every 15 minutes and place the meshes side by side in AR as a physical timeline. Twist: stack them in one spot with fading transparency instead of in a row.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机每 15 分钟扫描一次植物、熟睡的宠物或越堆越高的碗盘，在 AR 中把这些网格并排摆成一条实体时间线。变体：不排成一行，而是在同一位置叠加，越早的越透明。

works.title: fly revolver
works.description: Houseflies live inside an acrylic sphere in front of a target; a camera tracks where they are and a robotic mount aims a revolver at that spot in real time, triggering it when a single fly is detected.
works.description_zh: 几只家蝇生活在靶子前的一个亚克力球里；摄像头追踪它们的位置，机械云台实时把一把左轮手枪对准那里，只检测到一只苍蝇时就扣动扳机。
works.idea_en: Handing control to an unpredictable living agent creates tension no script can — AR characters can borrow behaviour from real creatures tracked by the camera.
works.idea_zh: 把控制权交给一个不可预测的活物，会产生剧本给不了的张力——AR 角色可以借用摄像头追踪到的真实生物的行为。
works.technique: Video tracking finds the flies' positions on the target backdrop and custom software sends pan/tilt angles to a robotic device holding the (unloaded, dry-fired) revolver.
works.technique_zh: 视频追踪找出苍蝇在靶子背景上的位置，自定义软件把水平/俯仰角度发送给握着左轮（空枪击发）的机械装置。
works.exercise_en: Track a moving object in the camera feed (a fish, a ball, a pet) and make a virtual spotlight or creature in AR follow it and react when it stops. Twist: let the tracked animal 'choose' which of several AR buttons to press.
works.exercise_zh: 在摄像头画面中追踪一个移动物体（鱼、球、宠物），让 AR 中的虚拟聚光灯或生物跟随它，并在它停下时做出反应。变体：让被追踪的动物“选择”按下几个 AR 按钮中的哪一个。

works.title: cloud piano
works.description: A camera looks at the sky and a robot presses the keys of a real piano according to the shapes of the clouds passing over, so the clouds seem to play music.
works.description_zh: 摄像头对着天空，机器人根据飘过的云的形状按下真钢琴的琴键，看起来就像云在弹奏音乐。
works.idea_en: Reading the sky as a score shows that any live view can become an instrument — a direct pattern for camera-driven AR sound.
works.idea_zh: 把天空当乐谱读，说明任何实时画面都可以变成乐器——这是摄像头驱动 AR 声音的直接模式。
works.technique: Custom software maps cloud edges in the live video to key positions across the keyboard and drives a row of robotic fingers that press them.
works.technique_zh: 自定义软件把实时视频中云的边缘映射到键盘上的琴键位置，并驱动一排机械手指按下它们。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at the sky, threshold the clouds, and let a virtual keyboard floating in AR play the notes that the cloud edges cross. Twist: aim it at a crowd or traffic instead of clouds.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准天空，对云做阈值分割，让漂浮在 AR 中的虚拟键盘弹出云的边缘经过的音符。变体：改对准人群或车流，而不是云。

works.title: plant drone
works.description: A drone carries a live plant whose leaf signals decide the flight path; an LED on the drone and an open camera shutter on the ground turn the plant's piloting into long-exposure drawings in the night sky.
works.description_zh: 一架无人机载着一株活植物，由叶片的信号决定飞行路线；无人机上的 LED 加上地面相机的长时间曝光，把植物“驾驶”的轨迹变成夜空中的光绘。
works.idea_en: Letting a non-human pilot draw in the sky and capturing the path with long exposure is a ready-made recipe for AR light trails.
works.idea_zh: 让一个非人类的“飞行员”在天空作画，并用长曝光记录路径，这是 AR 光轨的现成配方。
works.technique: Variable-resistance readings from each leaf are mapped to the drone's roll, pitch and altitude, while a long-exposure photograph records the LED path.
works.technique_zh: 每片叶子的可变电阻读数被映射为无人机的横滚、俯仰和高度，同时用长曝光照片记录 LED 的路径。
works.exercise_en: Attach a virtual light to a moving real object (a toy car, your hand, a friend walking) with AR tracking and let it leave a persistent glowing trail in the room. Twist: let a random or plant-like signal steer a virtual drone instead of a person.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 追踪把一个虚拟光点附着在移动的真实物体上（玩具车、你的手、走路的朋友），让它在房间里留下持久的发光轨迹。变体：改让随机的或类似植物的信号去操控一架虚拟无人机。

works.title: bit.fall
works.description: A row of nozzles releases water drops in precise patterns so that, for a moment, falling water spells out words picked live from online news, lit from the side.
works.description_zh: 一排喷嘴按精确的图案放出水滴，于是在一瞬间，下落的水写出实时从网络新闻中抓取的词语，并被侧面的灯照亮。
works.idea_en: Information that exists only while it falls teaches AR designers that text in space can be temporary, physical-feeling and tied to gravity.
works.idea_zh: 只在下落时存在的信息提醒 AR 设计者：空间中的文字可以是短暂的、有物理感的、受重力支配的。
works.technique: Around 128 magnetic valves open for milliseconds in sequence, like a one-line printer, so each word is 'printed' as a curtain of drops whose shape holds for about a second.
works.technique_zh: 约 128 个电磁阀按顺序开启几毫秒，像一台单行打印机，每个词都被“打印”成一帘水滴，形状能保持大约一秒。
works.exercise_en: Make words from a live feed (headlines, chat messages) fall as particle drops from a line anchored to a real doorway or ceiling in AR, dissolving when they hit the floor. Twist: let the viewer's hand catch and hold a word.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让实时来源的词语（新闻标题、聊天消息）化作粒子水滴，从锚定在真实门框或天花板上的一条线落下，落地即消散。变体：让观众用手接住并托住一个词。

works.title: bit.flow
works.description: Coloured liquid and air bubbles are pumped through a long transparent tube wound across a wall, forming pixel patterns and words that travel along the tube.
works.description_zh: 有色液体和气泡被泵入一条在墙上盘绕的长透明管道，形成像素图案和文字，沿着管道流动。
works.idea_en: Pixels do not need a screen: any flowing material can carry an image through space, which suggests AR content that travels along real pipes, rails or paths.
works.idea_zh: 像素不一定需要屏幕：任何流动的材料都能把图像带过空间，这启发 AR 内容沿真实的管道、栏杆或路径流动。
works.technique: Pumps and valves insert liquid and air segments at a computed rhythm so that, as the column moves through the coiled tube, the sequence lines up as a readable image; exact control is likely timing-based.
works.technique_zh: 水泵和阀门按计算好的节奏注入液体段和空气段，液柱在盘管中移动时这些段会排成可读的图像；精确控制很可能基于时序。
works.exercise_en: Trace a real handrail, cable or pipe with AR and send a stream of coloured pixel beads along it that spell a short message as they pass. Twist: let viewers tap the rail to inject their own colour into the stream.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中描出一段真实的扶手、电缆或管道，沿它送出一串彩色像素珠，经过时拼出一条短消息。变体：让观众轻点扶手，把自己的颜色注入流中。

works.title: Mimosa
works.description: A wall of mechanical OLED 'flowers' opens, closes and glows as visitors move in front of it, like a plant reacting to touch.
works.description_zh: 一面由机械 OLED“花朵”组成的墙，会随着观众在前方的移动而开合、发光，像一株对触碰有反应的植物。
works.idea_en: Borrowing a plant's reflex (the mimosa folds when touched) gives a responsive surface an instantly readable personality — useful for AR objects that should feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 借用植物的反射（含羞草被碰就合拢），能让一个响应式表面马上有可读的“性格”——适合需要显得有生命的 AR 物体。
works.technique: Likely camera or proximity sensing drives small motors that open petal-shaped OLED panels and set their brightness according to how close people are.
works.technique_zh: 很可能由摄像头或接近传感器驱动小电机，打开花瓣形的 OLED 面板，并根据人的远近调节亮度。
works.exercise_en: Place a bed of virtual flowers on a real wall in AR that fold shut when the phone or a tracked hand comes near and slowly reopen when it leaves. Twist: make them remember visitors and close faster for people who approach quickly.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一片虚拟花朵贴在真实墙面上，手机或被追踪的手靠近时它们合拢，离开后慢慢张开。变体：让它们“记住”访客，对快速靠近的人合得更快。

works.title: The Nature Trail
works.description: Along a hospital corridor at Great Ormond Street, LED animals hidden behind a patterned wall appear and walk beside children as they are wheeled to surgery.
works.description_zh: 在大奥蒙德街儿童医院的一条走廊里，藏在图案墙后的 LED 动物会出现，陪着被推往手术室的孩子们一起“走”。
works.idea_en: Content that appears only when someone passes and walks with them turns a stressful route into a companion — a direct template for location-based AR wayfinding.
works.idea_zh: 只在有人经过时出现并陪着走的内容，把一段令人紧张的路变成了陪伴——这是基于位置的 AR 导引的直接模板。
works.technique: Motion sensors along the corridor trigger LED animations embedded behind laser-cut wall panels, so animals reveal themselves in sequence at the pace of the passer-by.
works.technique_zh: 沿走廊布置的运动传感器触发嵌在激光切割墙板后的 LED 动画，动物按路人的步速依次现身。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR walk along a real corridor where small animals peek out from anchored spots and follow the user at walking pace. Twist: make the animals shy — they only come out if the user walks slowly and quietly.
works.exercise_zh: 沿一条真实走廊做一段 AR 漫步，小动物从锚定的位置探出头，按用户的步速跟随。变体：让动物很害羞——只有用户慢慢地、安静地走时它们才出来。

works.title: Wind to Light
works.description: A field of small wind turbines each powers its own light, so gusts sweeping across the site show up as waves of brightness.
works.description_zh: 一片小型风力涡轮机各自为自己的灯供电，于是掠过场地的阵风就显现为一波波的亮度变化。
works.idea_en: Wiring each light to its own local sensor makes an invisible field (wind) readable at a glance; AR can overlay the same kind of field map on a real place.
works.idea_zh: 让每盏灯只连接自己的本地传感器，一个看不见的场（风）就能一眼读出来；AR 可以在真实场所上叠加同样的场分布图。
works.technique: Each micro turbine drives an LED directly or via a small controller, so brightness is a live measure of local wind speed; the exact electronics are a guess.
works.technique_zh: 每台微型涡轮直接或通过小控制器驱动一盏 LED，亮度就是当地风速的实时读数；具体电路为推测。
works.exercise_en: Scatter virtual lamps across a park or courtyard in AR and set each one's brightness from a shared wind or noise signal with a small delay per position, so gusts appear to travel. Twist: use the phone microphone so voices light up the field.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把虚拟灯撒在公园或庭院里，用同一个风或噪声信号按位置加一点延迟来设定每盏灯的亮度，让阵风看起来在移动。变体：改用手机麦克风，让人声点亮整片灯阵。

works.title: Hylozoic Ground
works.description: At the Venice Architecture Biennale, a forest-like canopy of thousands of acrylic fronds, feathers and glass vessels ripples, breathes and glows as visitors walk beneath it.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯建筑双年展上，由成千上万片亚克力叶片、羽毛和玻璃容器组成的森林般的穹顶，在观众从下方走过时起伏、呼吸、发光。
works.idea_en: Thousands of tiny local reactions add up to a room that feels alive; in AR, many small agents reacting to nearby people beat one big scripted animation.
works.idea_zh: 成千上万个微小的局部反应加起来，就是一个仿佛有生命的房间；在 AR 里，许多对附近人群做出反应的小单元胜过一个大型脚本动画。
works.technique: Capacitive and infrared proximity sensors feed a distributed network of microcontrollers that pull shape-memory-alloy wires, moving fronds and triggering lights in waves that spread outward.
works.technique_zh: 电容和红外接近传感器把信号送入一个分布式微控制器网络，由它们拉动形状记忆合金丝，带动叶片并触发灯光，形成向外扩散的波。
works.exercise_en: Fill a ceiling in AR with hundreds of simple fronds that each bend toward the nearest tracked hand and pass the motion on to their neighbours. Twist: add a slow 'breathing' rhythm that pauses when nobody is present.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把天花板铺满几百片简单的叶片，每片都朝最近的被追踪的手弯曲，并把动作传给相邻的叶片。变体：加一个缓慢的“呼吸”节律，没人时暂停。

works.title: Sibyl
works.description: For the Sydney Biennale, a suspended cloud of lace-like meshes, glass flasks and lights shivers and pulses in response to visitors below.
works.description_zh: 为悉尼双年展制作的一团悬浮的蕾丝状网格云，挂着玻璃烧瓶和灯，会随下方观众而颤动、闪烁。
works.idea_en: A suspended form that trembles when you look up at it shows how overhead space — often ignored in AR — can host responsive content.
works.idea_zh: 一个你抬头看它就会颤动的悬浮形体，说明头顶的空间（AR 常常忽略的地方）也可以放置会回应的内容。
works.technique: A mesh of laser-cut components is threaded with sensors, LEDs and shape-memory actuators controlled by a networked set of microcontrollers.
works.technique_zh: 激光切割的构件编成网格，穿插着传感器、LED 和形状记忆执行器，由联网的一组微控制器控制。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a floating AR lattice above the viewer's head and make its nodes flicker and sag toward whoever is directly below. Twist: let two viewers' positions create interference patterns in the lattice.
works.exercise_zh: 在观众头顶锚定一个漂浮的 AR 网格，让它的节点朝正下方的人闪烁、下垂。变体：让两位观众的位置在网格里形成干涉图案。

works.title: Meander
works.description: A long hanging landscape in Cambridge, Ontario whose fronds, lights and sound respond to visitors with behaviours that learn and drift over time.
works.description_zh: 安大略省剑桥市的一条长长的悬挂景观，叶片、灯光和声音会回应观众，而且这些行为会随时间学习和漂移。
works.idea_en: A responsive space with its own slowly changing mood feels more alive than one that reacts identically every time — a lesson for persistent AR worlds.
works.idea_zh: 一个有自己缓慢变化“情绪”的响应空间，比每次都做出同样反应的空间更有生命感——这对持久化的 AR 世界是个启发。
works.technique: Sensor data from the crowd feeds behaviour software (reportedly with machine-learning components) that sets light, sound and actuator patterns across a distributed network.
works.technique_zh: 来自人群的传感数据输入行为软件（据介绍含有机器学习组件），在分布式网络上设定灯光、声音和执行器的模式。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR installation whose reaction to visitors (colour, speed, sound) slowly drifts based on how many people visited in the last hour, stored in a simple server. Twist: let it become 'sleepy' after crowds and 'curious' after silence.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 装置，它对访客的反应（颜色、速度、声音）根据过去一小时的访客数量缓慢变化，数据存在一个简单服务器上。变体：人多之后它变“困”，安静之后它变“好奇”。

works.title: Grove
works.description: At the 2021 Venice Architecture Biennale, a dense grove of hanging fronds, lights and speakers forms a walk-in environment that murmurs and glows around visitors.
works.description_zh: 在 2021 年威尼斯建筑双年展上，由悬挂的叶片、灯光和扬声器组成的密林形成一个可以走进去的环境，在观众周围低语、发光。
works.idea_en: Surrounding a visitor with many soft, reacting elements creates immersion without any screen — a reminder that AR can build space with layers, not just objects.
works.idea_zh: 用许多柔软、会回应的元素包围观众，不需要屏幕也能产生沉浸感——提醒我们 AR 可以用层次来构建空间，而不只是放物体。
works.technique: Networked sensors, lights and a multichannel sound system are embedded in a suspended structure of 3D-printed and laser-cut components.
works.technique_zh: 联网的传感器、灯光和多声道音响嵌入在由 3D 打印和激光切割构件组成的悬挂结构中。
works.exercise_en: Build a walk-in AR grove of translucent hanging strands with spatial audio sources that brighten and whisper as the viewer passes. Twist: let each strand hold a short voice recording left by a previous visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建一个可以走进去的 AR 林子，挂满半透明的丝带和空间音源，观众经过时它们变亮并低语。变体：让每条丝带保存上一位访客留下的一段短语音。

works.title: Caress of the Gaze
works.description: A 3D-printed garment covered in quill-like spines ripples and lifts on the part of the body that an onlooker is looking at.
works.description_zh: 一件覆盖着羽刺状结构的 3D 打印服装，会在旁观者目光所及的身体部位起伏、竖起。
works.idea_en: Making another person's gaze visible on your body turns an invisible social signal into a physical response — the same move as gaze-driven AR effects.
works.idea_zh: 把别人的目光显现在你的身体上，就把一个看不见的社交信号变成了实体回应——这与由视线驱动的 AR 效果是同一种思路。
works.technique: A small camera with gaze and face tracking estimates where the viewer is looking, and shape-memory-alloy actuators under multi-material 3D-printed spines move that region.
works.technique_zh: 小型摄像头通过视线和人脸追踪估计观看者在看哪里，多材料 3D 打印羽刺下的形状记忆合金执行器就让那一片区域动起来。
works.exercise_en: Use face tracking on a phone pointed at a friend to detect where on their body you are looking, and grow AR spines or feathers at that spot. Twist: invert it so the feathers flatten and hide wherever they are looked at.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准朋友，用人脸追踪判断你在看他身体的哪个部位，并在那里长出 AR 刺或羽毛。变体：反过来，被看到的地方羽毛就收拢、躲起来。

works.title: Opale
works.description: A garment covered in a forest of fibre-optic strands bristles, trembles or calms depending on the facial expressions of the people around the wearer.
works.description_zh: 一件覆盖着光纤丝“森林”的服装，会根据穿着者周围人的面部表情竖起、颤抖或平静下来。
works.idea_en: Clothing that reacts to others' emotions shows a new kind of expressive interface; AR face filters can move from decorating yourself to answering others.
works.idea_zh: 会对他人情绪做出反应的服装展示了一种新的表达界面；AR 面部滤镜可以从装饰自己转向回应他人。
works.technique: A camera classifies nearby faces into expressions and drives pneumatic soft-robotic chambers under a silicone skin filled with fibre-optic strands.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头把附近的人脸分类为不同表情，并驱动硅胶皮下的气动软体机器人腔体，皮上布满光纤丝。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or ARKit effect that grows fur on the viewer's shoulders which bristles when the camera sees an angry face and softens for a smile. Twist: show the reaction on the person being filmed rather than the one filming.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 ARKit 做一个效果：在观众肩上长出毛发，摄像头看到生气的脸时毛发竖起，看到笑脸时变柔顺。变体：把反应显示在被拍的人身上，而不是拍摄者身上。

works.title: Iridescence
works.description: A collar of 200 flipping quills, inspired by a hummingbird's throat, changes colour and pattern in response to the movement and emotions of people nearby.
works.description_zh: 一个由 200 根可翻转羽管组成的领饰，灵感来自蜂鸟的喉羽，会根据附近人的动作和情绪改变颜色和图案。
works.idea_en: Flipping two-coloured elements is a cheap, readable display — an AR designer can reuse the flip as a visual language for attention and mood.
works.idea_zh: 翻转双色单元是一种便宜又易读的显示方式——AR 设计者可以把“翻转”当作表达注意力和情绪的视觉语言。
works.technique: A facial-tracking camera feeds an interactive system that drives an array of electromagnetically flipped quills, producing colour waves across the collar.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪摄像头把数据送入互动系统，驱动一组电磁翻转的羽管，在领饰上形成色彩波纹。
works.exercise_en: Cover a real object (a chair, a jacket, a doorframe) with a grid of AR flip-tiles that turn over in a ripple toward whichever face the camera sees. Twist: map smiles to one colour and frowns to the other.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个真实物体（椅子、外套、门框）上覆盖一格格 AR 翻转片，让它们朝摄像头看到的那张脸波浪式翻转。变体：笑容对应一种颜色，皱眉对应另一种。

works.title: The Living, Breathing Wall
works.description: A kinetic wall panel of flexible cells changes shape in response to people's speech and movement, opening and closing like a breathing skin.
works.description_zh: 一面由柔性单元组成的动态墙板，会根据人的说话和动作改变形状，像呼吸的皮肤一样开合。
works.idea_en: A wall that recognises speech and answers with shape shows how architecture can listen; AR can let real walls 'listen' the same way.
works.idea_zh: 一面能识别语音并以形状回应的墙，展示了建筑如何“倾听”；AR 可以让真实的墙以同样的方式“倾听”。
works.technique: Speech recognition and motion sensing drive shape-memory-alloy actuators that deform flexible panels; details of the control are likely custom Arduino code.
works.technique_zh: 语音识别和运动感应驱动形状记忆合金执行器，使柔性面板变形；控制细节很可能是自定义的 Arduino 代码。
works.exercise_en: Detect a real wall with plane detection and cover it with AR cells that open when the microphone hears a keyword and close in silence. Twist: give each speaker's voice pitch its own region of the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测找到一面真实的墙，覆盖上 AR 单元，麦克风听到某个关键词时它们张开，安静时合拢。变体：按说话人的音高把墙分成不同区域。

works.title: Synapse
works.description: A 3D-printed helmet whose surface opens and closes in response to the wearer's brain activity, lighting up as attention rises.
works.description_zh: 一顶 3D 打印的头盔，表面会随着佩戴者的脑电活动开合，注意力升高时会亮起。
works.idea_en: Showing an inner state (attention) on the outside of the body is a strong idea for AR wearables and social filters.
works.idea_zh: 把内在状态（注意力）显示在身体外部，是 AR 可穿戴和社交滤镜的一个有力点子。
works.technique: An EEG headset reads attention levels and drives actuators and lights embedded in a multi-material 3D-printed shell.
works.technique_zh: 脑电头戴设备读取注意力水平，驱动嵌在多材料 3D 打印外壳中的执行器和灯光。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR head-halo that opens like petals when a simple input rises (heart rate from a watch, typing speed, or microphone level). Twist: show it only to other people, never to the wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 头部光环，当某个简单输入升高时（手表心率、打字速度或麦克风音量）它像花瓣一样张开。变体：只让别人看到它，佩戴者自己看不到。

works.title: Water Light Graffiti
works.description: A wall of thousands of LEDs lights up wherever it is touched with water, so people paint glowing messages with brushes, sprayers or wet fingers that fade as the water dries.
works.description_zh: 一面由数千颗 LED 组成的墙，被水碰到的地方就会亮起，人们用刷子、喷壶或湿手指画出发光的留言，水干了光也就消失了。
works.idea_en: Painting with an everyday material that leaves no mark teaches AR designers to link virtual ink to a real gesture and to let drawings fade on their own.
works.idea_zh: 用不留痕迹的日常材料作画，提醒 AR 设计者：把虚拟墨水绑定到真实的手势上，并让画面自己慢慢消失。
works.technique: Each LED sits between two contacts on the surface; water bridges the contacts, closes the circuit and powers the light until it evaporates.
works.technique_zh: 每颗 LED 位于表面两个触点之间；水把触点连通，电路闭合、灯亮，直到水蒸发。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Lens Studio wall where a tracked fingertip or a sprayed 'virtual water' particle leaves glowing strokes that dry and fade over 30 seconds. Twist: make the strokes last longer the more people add to the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 做一面墙，被追踪的指尖或喷出的“虚拟水”粒子会留下发光笔触，并在 30 秒内干掉、消失。变体：同一处被越多人补画，笔触保留得越久。

works.title: Very Nervous System
works.description: In an empty room, a person's movements are watched by video cameras and turned instantly into music, so the body plays the space like an instrument.
works.description_zh: 在一个空房间里，摄像机观察人的动作并即时把它们变成音乐，身体像演奏乐器一样演奏整个空间。
works.idea_en: The whole body as the interface, with no visible device, is the root of camera-based interaction; AR sound can use the same idea with body tracking.
works.idea_zh: 整个身体就是界面、看不到任何设备，这是基于摄像头交互的源头；AR 声音可以借助身体追踪沿用同一想法。
works.technique: Custom image-processing hardware and software measure motion in regions of the camera image and map speed and location to synthesiser parameters in real time.
works.technique_zh: 自制的图像处理硬件和软件测量摄像画面各区域的运动，并把速度和位置实时映射到合成器参数上。
works.exercise_en: Divide the room into invisible AR zones and use body tracking so that moving fast or slow in each zone triggers different sounds. Twist: add a delay so the room 'answers' a second later, like an echo of your body.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间划分为看不见的 AR 区域，用身体追踪让人在每个区域里快动或慢动触发不同的声音。变体：加一点延迟，让房间晚一秒才“回答”，像身体的回声。

works.title: The Giver of Names
works.description: Visitors place any object on a pedestal; a computer looks at it with a camera and speaks aloud a strange, poetic sentence about what it thinks it sees.
works.description_zh: 观众把任何物品放在一个底座上；电脑用摄像头看着它，大声说出一句关于它“看到”了什么的奇怪而诗意的句子。
works.idea_en: A machine that names objects badly but beautifully shows how recognition can be poetic; AR object labels do not have to be literal.
works.idea_zh: 一台把物体命名得不准确却很美的机器，说明识别也可以是诗意的；AR 物体标签不必只做字面描述。
works.technique: The camera image is analysed for colour, shape and texture, and these features are fed into a network of word associations that generates grammatical sentences.
works.technique_zh: 系统分析摄像画面的颜色、形状和纹理，把这些特征输入一个词语联想网络，生成合乎语法的句子。
