works.title: Light Prop for an Electric Stage (Light-Space Modulator)
works.description: A motorised construction of perforated metal, glass and rods that rotates under coloured lamps, throwing moving shadows and reflections across a darkened room.
works.description_zh: 一台由穿孔金属、玻璃和金属杆构成的电动装置，在彩色灯光下旋转，把移动的阴影和反射投满黑暗的房间。
works.idea_en: The object matters less than the light it throws into the room; in AR, the effect an object has on the space around it can be more important than the object itself.
works.idea_zh: 物体本身不如它投进房间的光重要；在 AR 中，物体对周围空间的影响往往比物体本身更重要。
works.technique: Rotating perforated discs, a glass spiral and a sliding ball are lit by programmed coloured lamps, and their moving shadows form the actual artwork.
works.technique_zh: 旋转的穿孔圆盘、玻璃螺旋和滑动的小球被程序控制的彩色灯照亮，它们移动的影子才是真正的作品。
works.exercise_en: Build a virtual kinetic machine in AR that casts real-time shadows and light patterns onto the detected walls and floor, with the machine itself nearly invisible. Twist: let users only see the machine when they walk behind it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中做一台虚拟动态机器，把实时阴影和光纹投到识别出的墙面和地面上，而机器本身几乎不可见。变体：只有绕到它背后时才能看见机器本身。

works.title: Ein Lichtspiel Schwarz Weiss Grau
works.description: A short abstract film of the Light Prop in motion, in which reflections, shadows and multiple exposures turn the machine into a flowing play of black, white and grey.
works.description_zh: 一部拍摄“光道具”运转的抽象短片，反射、阴影和多重曝光把机器变成黑、白、灰流动交织的光影游戏。
works.idea_en: Filming a light machine with overlays and multiple exposures reveals motion as layered traces, which is how AR can show time and movement in a single frame.
works.idea_zh: 用叠加和多重曝光拍摄光机器，把运动呈现为层叠的痕迹，这正是 AR 在一个画面中展示时间与运动的方式。
works.technique: Close-ups, negative images and multiple exposures of the rotating machine layer successive moments of light over each other on film.
works.technique_zh: 对旋转机器的特写、负片和多重曝光，在胶片上把连续时刻的光层层叠加。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR camera filter that layers the last 30 frames of the live camera with decreasing opacity so moving lights leave multi-exposure trails. Twist: convert it to black, white and grey only and film a desk lamp spinning.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 相机滤镜，把实时画面最近的 30 帧以递减透明度叠加，让移动的光留下多重曝光轨迹。变体：只保留黑、白、灰，拍一盏旋转的台灯。

works.title: Room of the Present (Raum der Gegenwart)
works.description: A room Moholy-Nagy designed in 1930 to show new media (film, photography, a working Light Prop and architecture) together; it was realised for the first time in 2009 and shown at the Guggenheim.
works.description_zh: Moholy-Nagy 于 1930 年设计的房间，把电影、摄影、运转的“光道具”和建筑等新媒体放在一起展示；2009 年首次被实际建成，并在古根海姆展出。
works.idea_en: A room designed as a showcase for new media, where the space itself is part of the exhibit; AR exhibitions can treat the room as the interface.
works.idea_zh: 一个为新媒体设计的展示空间，空间本身就是展品的一部分；AR 展览也可以把房间当作界面。
works.technique: The environment combines projections, moving displays, photographs and a replica Light Prop in an architectural layout meant to be experienced as a whole.
works.technique_zh: 这个环境把投影、活动展示、照片和“光道具”复制品组合在一个整体体验的建筑布局中。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'room of the present' in a real room: pin a video on one wall, a 3D model on the table and a light machine on the ceiling, all linked to one timeline. Twist: let the room rearrange itself when a second visitor arrives.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实房间里设计一个 AR“当下之屋”：一面墙上钉一段视频，桌上放一个 3D 模型，天花板上挂一台光机器，都连在同一条时间线上。变体：第二位访客到来时，让房间自动重新布置。

works.title: Spazio elastico (Elastic Space)
works.description: A dark room crossed by a grid of fluorescent elastic cords glowing under ultraviolet light; motors slowly stretch the cords so the grid warps and the room's geometry seems to breathe.
works.description_zh: 黑暗房间里纵横交错的荧光弹性绳在紫外光下发光；电机缓慢拉伸绳子，让网格变形，整个房间的几何仿佛在呼吸。
works.idea_en: Distorting the grid that defines a space makes the space itself feel elastic; AR can warp the perceived room with glowing guide lines instead of objects.
works.idea_zh: 扭曲定义空间的网格，就能让空间本身显得有弹性；AR 可以用发光的辅助线而不是物体来扭曲人们感知到的房间。
works.technique: Fluorescent elastic cords form a 3D grid in a black room; motors pull individual cords so the lattice deforms slowly while UV light makes only the lines visible.
works.technique_zh: 荧光弹性绳在黑色房间中组成三维网格；电机拉动单根绳子，让网格缓慢变形，紫外光下只有线条可见。
works.exercise_en: Fill a dim real room with a glowing AR 3D grid (WebXR or Unity) and let one grid node slowly follow the user so the lattice bends around them. Twist: dim the passthrough so only the grid is visible, like a UV room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Unity 在昏暗的真实房间中填满发光的 AR 三维网格，并让一个网格节点缓慢跟随用户，使网格绕着他们弯曲。变体：调暗透视画面，只留网格可见，像紫外光房间一样。

works.title: Strutturazione pulsante (Pulsating Structure)
works.description: A white relief of small blocks that are pushed in and out by hidden motors, so the surface slowly pulses and changes its pattern of light and shadow.
works.description_zh: 由小方块组成的白色浮雕，被隐藏电机推进推出，表面缓慢脉动，光影图案随之改变。
works.idea_en: A surface that breathes by moving small pieces is a physical pixel display; AR can make real walls appear to pulse with the same displacement idea.
works.idea_zh: 通过移动小块来“呼吸”的表面是一种物理像素显示；AR 可以用同样的位移思路让真实墙面看起来在脉动。
works.technique: Motor-driven cams push individual blocks back and forth by a few centimetres, so the relief's shading pattern shifts continuously.
works.technique_zh: 电机驱动的凸轮把单个方块前后推动几厘米，让浮雕的明暗图案持续变化。
works.exercise_en: Overlay a detected real wall with an AR grid of blocks that push out and in like a breathing surface, driven by a noise field or the user's breath. Twist: make the blocks push out where the user's shadow falls.
works.exercise_zh: 在识别出的真实墙面上叠加一片 AR 方块阵列，由噪声场或用户的呼吸驱动，让它们像呼吸的表面一样推出、收回。变体：让方块在用户影子落下的地方凸出。

works.title: Topoestesia (itinerario programmato)
works.description: A walk-through environment of tilted floors, steps and narrow passages that throws visitors off balance and makes them feel space through their bodies rather than their eyes.
works.description_zh: 由倾斜地面、台阶和狭窄通道组成的可穿行环境，让观众失去平衡，用身体而不是眼睛去感受空间。
works.idea_en: Changing the ground under the feet changes perception more than any image; AR experiences can guide walking paths and pacing to shape how a space is felt.
works.idea_zh: 改变脚下的地面比任何图像都更能改变感知；AR 体验可以通过引导行走路线和节奏来塑造人们对空间的感受。
works.technique: A sequence of spaces with inclined planes and irregular steps is programmed as an itinerary, so the body's balance and movement become the medium.
works.technique_zh: 带斜面和不规则台阶的空间序列被编排成一条路线，身体的平衡与移动成为媒介。
works.exercise_en: Design a WebXR walk through a real corridor where AR floor markings, tilted virtual horizons and narrowing walls make the walker slow down and sway. Twist: make the virtual horizon tilt a little more with every step.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一条穿过真实走廊的 WebXR 路线，用 AR 地面标记、倾斜的虚拟地平线和逐渐收窄的墙让行人放慢并摇晃。变体：每走一步，让虚拟地平线再倾斜一点。

works.title: The Horse in Motion (Sallie Gardner at a Gallop)
works.description: Twelve cameras along a Palo Alto racetrack fire in turn as the horse breaks their tripwires, catching the gallop in a row of frames that shows all four hooves off the ground; played in sequence, the frames move.
works.description_zh: 帕洛阿尔托赛马场边的 12 台相机在马匹扯断绊线时依次拍摄，把一次奔跑拍成一排画面，证明了四蹄会同时离地；按顺序播放，画面就动了起来。
works.idea_en: Space the moments of a movement along a line and people can walk through time: lay out a motion as a row of frozen poses in AR and let the viewer's position choose the frame.
works.idea_zh: 把一个动作的各个瞬间沿一条线排开，人就能“走过”时间：在 AR 里把动作排成一排定格姿态，让观众站的位置决定看到哪一帧。
works.technique: A row of cameras with fast shutters is triggered by tripwires as the subject passes, so camera position encodes time.
works.technique_zh: 一排快门极快的相机由被摄物依次扯断的绊线触发，于是相机的位置就对应着时间。
works.exercise_en: Record a 2-second jump with a phone, extract 12 frames, cut out the person and place the cut-outs as billboards in a line on the floor in WebXR or Lens Studio. Twist: scrub the animation by walking along the row instead of pressing play.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一段 2 秒的跳跃，抽出 12 帧，把人抠出来，在 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 里把这些剪影沿地面排成一行；变体：不按播放键，而是沿着这排剪影走动来拖动动画。

works.title: Zoopraxiscope
works.description: A spinning glass disc painted with figures traced from Muybridge's photographs is projected through a counter-rotating shutter, so the horses and athletes appear to run on the screen; shown here as a working replica.
works.description_zh: 一张画着根据 Muybridge 照片描摹的人和马的玻璃圆盘在旋转，透过反向转动的快门投影出来，银幕上的马和运动员就跑了起来；视频里是一台可运转的复制品。
works.idea_en: Motion is an illusion built from still frames plus a shutter: an AR designer can make any looping animation feel physical by tying it to a real rotating object.
works.idea_zh: 运动是由静帧加快门造出来的错觉：把循环动画绑在一个真实转动的物体上，AR 设计师就能让它显得像实体。
works.technique: Sequential images on a rotating disc are projected through a synchronised slotted shutter, so each frame flashes briefly in place.
works.technique_zh: 旋转圆盘上的连续图像通过同步的开槽快门投影出去，每一帧都在原位短暂闪现。
works.exercise_en: Track a spinning record or lazy Susan with image tracking in Lens Studio or AR Foundation and attach a 12-frame loop that advances with the measured rotation angle. Twist: make the animation run backwards when the disc is spun the other way.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 中用图像追踪识别一张旋转的唱片或转盘，挂上一段 12 帧的循环动画，按测得的旋转角度推进帧；变体：反向转动圆盘时动画倒放。

works.title: The Attitudes of Animals in Motion: Athletes
works.description: Plates of athletes running, jumping and somersaulting against a numbered grid, each movement broken into a dozen poses; here animated back into motion from the original photographs.
works.description_zh: 运动员在编号网格前奔跑、跳跃、翻跟头，每个动作被拆成十几个姿态；视频把原始照片重新串成动画。
works.idea_en: A measuring grid behind a moving body turns a gesture into data you can read — the same role a visible AR floor grid can play when teaching movement.
works.idea_zh: 运动的身体背后放一张测量网格，动作就变成可以读的数据——在教动作时，AR 里可见的地面网格也能起同样的作用。
works.technique: Multiple cameras photograph the subject in front of a lined backdrop so positions can be compared frame to frame.
works.technique_zh: 多台相机在画着格线的背景前拍摄，便于逐帧比较位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR scene with a 1 m grid on the floor and record a friend's body pose with a phone pose-tracking model, then replay the skeleton as 10 translucent snapshots over the grid. Twist: color each snapshot by speed so fast phases glow.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 场景的地面放一张 1 米网格，用手机的人体姿态模型记录同伴的动作，再把骨架以 10 个半透明快照的形式回放在网格上；变体：按速度给每个快照上色，让快的阶段发亮。

works.title: Animal Locomotion
works.description: The University of Pennsylvania series of 781 plates showing people and animals walking, carrying, climbing and flying, shot from several angles at once; the frames are animated in this video.
works.description_zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学支持的 781 张图版，从多个角度同时拍摄人和动物行走、搬运、攀爬和飞行；视频把这些画面重新动了起来。
works.idea_en: Shooting one motion from several sides at once is volumetric capture in its earliest form — the idea behind today's AR volumetric people.
works.idea_zh: 从几个方向同时拍同一个动作，就是最早的体积捕捉——今天 AR 中立体人像的思路正源于此。
works.technique: Banks of cameras at the side, front and back are fired by an electrical clockwork timer so each phase is seen from multiple viewpoints.
works.technique_zh: 侧面、正面和背面的多组相机由电动钟表计时器依次触发，每个动作阶段都能从多个视角看到。
works.exercise_en: Film one short action from three phones placed at 0, 90 and 180 degrees, then place the three clips as synced vertical panels around a point in AR so walking around the point switches views. Twist: replace the panels with a single Gaussian-splat or photogrammetry capture and compare.
works.exercise_zh: 用三部手机在 0°、90°、180° 同时拍一个短动作，在 AR 中把三段同步视频作为竖直面板围绕一个点摆放，绕着走就会切换视角；变体：换成一次 Gaussian splat 或摄影测量捕捉，比较两者的效果。

works.title: Chronophotography on a Fixed Plate
works.description: Athletes in black suits with white lines and dots run, jump and fence in front of a dark shed; a rotating shutter records many phases on one plate, so the body becomes a fan of overlapping lines.
works.description_zh: 身穿画着白线白点的黑衣运动员在暗色棚子前奔跑、跳跃、击剑；旋转快门把许多个瞬间记录在同一张底片上，身体变成一扇扇重叠的线条。
works.idea_en: Reduce the body to a few bright lines and a whole movement fits in one image: stick-figure trails are often clearer than full avatars in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把身体简化成几条亮线，整个动作就能装进一张图：在 AR 里，火柴人式的轨迹往往比完整的虚拟人更清楚。
works.technique: A slotted rotating disc exposes one photographic plate at regular intervals while the subject, dressed to reflect only along limbs, moves against black.
works.technique_zh: 开槽旋转圆盘让同一张底片按固定间隔曝光，被摄者只在四肢上有反光标记，在黑色背景前运动。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone body-tracking API (ARKit body tracking or MediaPipe in WebXR) to draw only the limb segments of a moving person and keep every 5th frame on screen as a fading echo. Twist: let the viewer freeze the whole fan in space and walk around it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机人体追踪（ARKit 人体追踪或 WebXR 中的 MediaPipe）只画出运动者四肢的线段，每隔 5 帧保留一次，作为渐隐的残影；变体：让观众把整把“扇子”冻结在空中并绕着看。

works.title: Flight of a Gull (zoetrope sculptures)
works.description: Plaster and bronze gulls modelled from chronophotographs of a single wingbeat sit in a ring inside a zoetrope; when it spins behind slits, the sculpted bird flies in 3D.
works.description_zh: 根据一次扇翅的连续照片塑造出的一组石膏和青铜海鸥排成一圈放在走马盘里；转盘在缝隙后旋转时，雕塑的鸟便在三维中飞了起来。
works.idea_en: Motion can be stored as a ring of physical keyframes: an AR designer can animate by swapping solid sculptures rather than deforming one mesh.
works.idea_zh: 运动可以存成一圈实体关键帧：AR 设计师可以通过切换一组实心雕塑来做动画，而不是让一个网格变形。
works.technique: Each phase of the wingbeat is sculpted as a separate object and viewed through a spinning slotted drum, which flashes each object in turn.
works.technique_zh: 扇翅的每个阶段都被做成一个独立雕塑，透过旋转的开槽转筒观看，每个雕塑依次闪现。
works.exercise_en: Model or photogrammetry-scan 8 poses of a hand opening and closing, place them in a ring in AR, and show only one at a time at 12 fps as the ring rotates. Twist: slow the rotation until viewers see the individual sculptures again.
works.exercise_zh: 用建模或摄影测量得到手张开合拢的 8 个姿态，在 AR 中排成一圈，转盘旋转时以每秒 12 帧只显示其中一个；变体：把转速放慢，直到观众重新看到一个个独立的雕塑。

works.title: Chronophotographic Films
works.description: Short films from Marey's Station Physiologique: horses, cats falling and turning in the air, fencers, athletes and birds, recorded on moving film strips with his chronophotographic camera.
works.description_zh: 来自 Marey 生理站的短片：马、在空中下落并翻身的猫、击剑手、运动员和鸟，都由他的连续摄影机拍在移动的胶片上。
works.idea_en: Slow motion reveals rules the eye cannot see, like a cat righting itself mid-air: AR replays at a fraction of real speed can teach physical skills.
works.idea_zh: 慢动作能揭示肉眼看不到的规律，比如猫如何在空中翻正身体：以远低于真实速度的 AR 回放可以用来教身体技能。
works.technique: A camera with an intermittent film transport records dozens of frames per second on paper or celluloid strips.
works.technique_zh: 带间歇式输片机构的相机在纸基或赛璐珞胶片上每秒记录几十帧。
works.exercise_en: Capture a friend throwing a ball with the phone's slow-motion mode and place the clip life-size in AR where it happened, playing at 1/8 speed. Twist: add a draggable timeline ring on the floor to scrub the throw by walking.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机慢动作模式拍下同伴投球，把视频按真人大小放回 AR 中原来的位置，以 1/8 速度播放；变体：在地面加一圈可拖动的时间环，走动即可拖动这次投掷。

works.title: Smoke Machine (Mouvements de l'air)
works.description: Parallel threads of smoke flow through a glass chamber and bend around obstacles of different shapes, making the invisible air current visible and photographable.
works.description_zh: 一排平行的烟丝流过玻璃风洞，绕过不同形状的障碍物时发生弯曲，看不见的气流因此显形并能被拍下来。
works.idea_en: Invisible fields become readable when you seed them with visible tracers: AR can show wind, WiFi or sound as streams of particles bending around real objects.
works.idea_zh: 给看不见的场撒上可见的示踪物，它就变得可读：AR 可以把风、WiFi 或声音显示成绕过真实物体弯曲的粒子流。
works.technique: Evenly spaced smoke streams are fed into a laminar air flow in front of a black background and photographed as they deflect around models.
works.technique_zh: 等距的烟流注入黑色背景前的层流空气中，绕过模型发生偏折时被拍摄下来。
works.exercise_en: Scan a desk with LiDAR and run a simple 2D flow field in Unity or three.js so particle streamlines bend around the scanned objects. Twist: let the user blow into the microphone to change the flow speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 扫描一张桌面，在 Unity 或 three.js 里运行一个简单的二维流场，让粒子流线绕过扫描到的物体；变体：让用户对着麦克风吹气来改变流速。

works.title: Quicker 'n a Wink
works.description: Academy Award-winning MGM short in which Edgerton's stroboscope freezes and slows down everyday actions — a golf swing, a drop of water, a spinning fan — revealing motions too fast for the eye.
works.description_zh: 获奥斯卡奖的 MGM 短片：Edgerton 的频闪仪把日常动作——挥杆、水滴、旋转的风扇——定格或放慢，展示肉眼跟不上的运动。
works.idea_en: A strobe light lets a still eye see a fast world; AR effects that flash or sample the camera feed can reveal hidden rhythms in ordinary motion.
works.idea_zh: 频闪灯让静止的眼睛看清快速的世界；对相机画面做闪烁或抽帧处理的 AR 效果，同样能揭示日常运动中隐藏的节奏。
works.technique: A gas-discharge stroboscope flashes at a precise rate so a rotating or repeating motion appears frozen or slowed.
works.technique_zh: 气体放电频闪仪以精确的频率闪光，让旋转或重复的运动看上去被定格或放慢。
works.exercise_en: Build a Lens Studio or WebAR filter that shows the camera image only every Nth frame and holds it, with a slider for N, then point it at a fan, a swing or a dripping tap. Twist: tap a beat on screen to set the strobe rate by rhythm.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 WebAR 里做一个滤镜，每隔 N 帧才显示并保持一次相机画面，用滑块调节 N，然后对准风扇、秋千或滴水的龙头；变体：在屏幕上敲拍子来设定频闪速率。

works.title: Milk Drop Coronet
works.description: A single drop of milk hitting a plate is frozen by a microsecond flash at the instant it forms a perfect crown of droplets.
works.description_zh: 一滴牛奶落在盘子上，在溅成完美皇冠形的瞬间被微秒闪光定格。
works.idea_en: Freezing one exact instant turns ordinary events into sculptures: AR can let people pause the world at a chosen moment and walk around it.
works.idea_zh: 定格一个精确的瞬间，就能把普通事件变成雕塑：AR 可以让人在选定的时刻暂停世界，并绕着它走。
works.technique: A sound or light trigger fires an electronic flash lasting a few microseconds, so a normal camera with an open shutter records a sharp instant.
works.technique_zh: 声音或光电触发器点亮一次只持续几微秒的电子闪光，让快门打开的普通相机记录下清晰的一瞬间。
works.exercise_en: Capture a splash with the phone's 240 fps mode, pick the most sculptural frame, turn it into a depth-based 3D relief with a depth-estimation model and place it on a real table in AR. Twist: let the viewer tap to advance the frozen splash by one frame at a time.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 240 fps 拍一次水花，挑出最有雕塑感的一帧，用深度估计模型转成三维浮雕，放到 AR 里的真实桌面上；变体：让观众每点一次屏幕，冻结的水花就前进一帧。

works.title: Bullet through Apple
works.description: A .30 caliber bullet is caught leaving an apple that is exploding on both sides, frozen by a flash lasting about a third of a millionth of a second.
works.description_zh: 一颗 .30 口径子弹穿出苹果的瞬间被约三分之一微秒的闪光定格，苹果两侧正在爆开。
works.idea_en: Violent, invisible events become calm and readable when frozen; AR replays can slow dangerous physics to a speed where people can study them safely.
works.idea_zh: 剧烈而看不见的事件一旦被定格，就变得平静可读；AR 回放可以把危险的物理过程放慢到人们能安全研究的速度。
works.technique: The sound of the gunshot triggers a very short electronic flash in a dark room while the camera shutter is already open.
works.technique_zh: 在暗室中相机快门已打开，枪声触发一次极短的电子闪光。
works.exercise_en: Simulate a projectile passing through a virtual fruit in Unity with a mesh-fracture asset, then place the frozen mid-impact moment in AR at table scale with a time slider. Twist: let the viewer set the exact microsecond to freeze by pinching the slider.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 中用网格破碎插件模拟子弹穿过虚拟水果，把撞击中途的冻结瞬间以桌面尺寸放进 AR，并配一个时间滑块；变体：让观众用捏合手势精确选择要定格的那一微秒。

works.title: Picasso Light Drawings
works.description: In a darkened room in Vallauris, Pablo Picasso draws a centaur, a bull and his signature in the air with a small flashlight while Mili's open-shutter camera records the glowing lines.
works.description_zh: 在瓦洛里一间暗下来的房间里，Pablo Picasso 用小手电在空中画出半人马、公牛和自己的签名，Mili 的相机开着快门记录下这些发光的线。
works.idea_en: A drawing in the air lasts only as long as someone records it: AR finally makes these gestures persistent and walkable.
works.idea_zh: 空中的画只有被记录下来才会留存：AR 终于让这样的手势持久存在，并且可以绕着走。
works.technique: Long exposure in the dark with a moving point light, combined with a short flash to reveal the artist's figure.
works.technique_zh: 在黑暗中长曝光拍摄移动的点光源，再配一次短闪光把艺术家本人照出来。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Lens Studio air-drawing tool that traces the phone or fingertip as a glowing tube, and ask each student to draw one animal in a single continuous line. Twist: the line fades after 10 seconds unless someone else walks through it.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 空中绘画工具，把手机或指尖的轨迹画成发光的管子，让每位学生用一笔连续的线画一只动物；变体：线条 10 秒后消失，除非有人从它中间走过。

works.title: Cyclegraphs and Chronocyclegraphs
works.description: Small bulbs on a worker's hands leave bright paths on long-exposure photographs of drilling and assembly tasks; interrupted lights add dots that show speed and direction.
works.description_zh: 工人手上绑着小灯泡，在钻孔、装配等工作的长曝光照片上留下明亮路径；间歇闪烁的灯再加上表示速度和方向的点。
works.idea_en: A light trail is also a measurement: AR hand-tracking trails can double as feedback that teaches a smoother, shorter motion.
works.idea_zh: 光迹同时也是一种测量：AR 的手部追踪轨迹可以兼作反馈，教人做出更顺、更短的动作。
works.technique: Long exposures record small lamps on the hands; in the chronocyclegraph the lamps are pulsed so dot spacing shows velocity (dates approximate).
works.technique_zh: 长曝光记录手上的小灯；计时光迹法让灯按节奏闪烁，点的间距就代表速度（年代为大致时间）。
works.exercise_en: Use hand tracking on a headset or phone to record the path of a fingertip while a student ties a knot, then draw the path as dots spaced by time. Twist: show an expert's path in a second color and score the difference.
works.exercise_zh: 用头显或手机的手部追踪记录学生打结时指尖的路径，把路径画成按时间间隔分布的点；变体：用另一种颜色显示专家的路径，并给两者的差异打分。

works.title: Lightmobile
works.description: A Volkswagen Beetle covered with about 1,600 computer-controlled light bulbs drives through city streets, its patterns chasing across the body as it moves.
works.description_zh: 一辆覆盖约 1600 个电脑控制灯泡的大众甲壳虫在城市街道上行驶，灯光图案在车身上追逐流动。
works.idea_en: Light content does not have to stay on buildings: attaching animated light to a moving object makes the street itself the stage, a cue for AR content that rides on vehicles.
works.idea_zh: 光的内容不必只停在建筑上：把动态光附在移动的物体上，整条街就成了舞台——这给“跟着交通工具走”的 AR 内容一个提示。
works.technique: Hundreds of bulbs on the car body are sequenced by an onboard computer to run chase and pattern animations.
works.technique_zh: 车身上的数百个灯泡由车载电脑排序控制，播放追逐和图案动画。
works.exercise_en: Track a toy car or a bike with image or object tracking and wrap it in an animated pattern of virtual bulbs that chase in the direction of travel. Twist: make the chase speed follow the real speed of the object.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像或物体追踪识别一辆玩具车或自行车，给它包上一层虚拟灯泡动画，灯光沿行进方向追逐；变体：让追逐速度跟随物体的真实速度。

works.title: Light Graffiti in Cologne (Tracks feature)
works.description: Arte's Tracks follows Lichtfaktor writing glowing letters and figures on Cologne streets with flashlights during long exposures, alongside other new graffiti forms.
works.description_zh: Arte 电视台的 Tracks 节目跟拍 Lichtfaktor 在科隆街头用手电在长曝光中写出发光的字母和人形，也介绍了其他新的涂鸦形式。
works.idea_en: Graffiti made of light leaves no mark on the wall; AR street art can be just as temporary and still tied to a specific corner.
works.idea_zh: 用光做的涂鸦不会在墙上留下痕迹；AR 街头艺术也可以一样短暂，却仍然绑定在某个具体的街角。
works.technique: Several painters draw with handheld LEDs in front of a camera on a tripod set to a long exposure.
works.technique_zh: 几位画手在三脚架上长曝光的相机前，用手持 LED 灯作画。
works.exercise_en: Make a geo-anchored light-graffiti app with persistent anchors (ARCore Geospatial or Niantic Lightship) where a stroke drawn in the air stays at that street corner for others to find. Twist: each tag fades a little every time someone views it.
works.exercise_zh: 用持久锚点（ARCore Geospatial 或 Niantic Lightship）做一个带地理锚定的光涂鸦应用，在空中画下的笔画会留在那个街角等别人发现；变体：每被看一次，涂鸦就变淡一点。

works.title: The Very Angry Caterpillar
works.description: A light-painted caterpillar crawls, eats and grows across walls and floors, animated from hundreds of long exposures made with the BBC children's show Blue Peter.
works.description_zh: 一条光绘的毛毛虫在墙面和地面上爬行、进食、长大，由与 BBC 儿童节目 Blue Peter 合作拍摄的几百张长曝光照片组成。
works.idea_en: Stop-motion light drawing gives a character a real path through a real room — a low-tech prototype for AR characters that walk on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 定格光绘让角色在真实房间里走出一条真实的路线——这是会在真实表面上行走的 AR 角色的低技术原型。
works.technique: Each frame is a separate long exposure in which the painters redraw the character slightly further along its path; the frames are sequenced into video.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧都是一张单独的长曝光，画手们把角色沿路线往前挪一点重新画一遍，再把这些帧连成视频。
works.exercise_en: Record a hand-drawn 3D stroke creature in an AR drawing tool, then script it to crawl along a detected plane and climb a wall using plane detection. Twist: the creature grows one segment every time it reaches a real object.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 绘画工具里手绘一只三维线条小生物，然后用平面检测写脚本，让它沿地面爬行并爬上墙；变体：它每碰到一个真实物体就长出一节。

works.title: dENiZEN — Light Painting Video
works.description: A music video painted over four cold nights in Cologne: dozens of friends draw flowing shapes, faces and words in light around streets and buildings, frame by frame.
works.description_zh: 在科隆四个寒冷的夜晚绘制的音乐录影带：几十位朋友在街道和建筑周围一帧一帧地用光画出流动的形状、人脸和文字。
works.idea_en: Many people drawing together in one frame produces a density no single artist could reach; shared AR drawing sessions can build the same collective scenes.
works.idea_zh: 许多人同时在一个画面里作画，能达到单个艺术家达不到的密度；多人共享的 AR 绘画也能构建出这样的集体场景。
works.technique: A large crew performs coordinated light strokes during each long exposure and repeats them with small changes for stop-motion.
works.technique_zh: 一大群人在每次长曝光中完成协调好的光笔画，再以细微变化重复，做成定格动画。
works.exercise_en: Set up a multi-user AR drawing room (e.g. Unity + Netcode or 8th Wall shared sessions) where four students draw simultaneously around one anchor for 60 seconds. Twist: each student may only draw in their assigned color and height band.
works.exercise_zh: 搭一个多人 AR 绘画空间（如 Unity + Netcode 或 8th Wall 共享会话），让四位学生围绕一个锚点同时画 60 秒；变体：每人只能用指定的颜色、只在指定的高度区间作画。

works.title: Luma Paint — Interactive Light Graffiti
works.description: At the Luminale festival visitors pick up light pens and draw in front of a camera; a live long-exposure picture builds up on a large screen so everyone sees their strokes appear instantly.
works.description_zh: 在 Luminale 灯光节上，观众拿起光笔在摄像头前作画，大屏幕上实时累积出一张长曝光画面，每个人都能立刻看到自己的笔画。
works.idea_en: Turning a slow photographic technique into instant feedback makes it a public game: live accumulation of traces is a strong AR interaction on its own.
works.idea_zh: 把慢速的摄影技巧变成即时反馈，它就成了公共游戏：实时累积的轨迹本身就是很强的 AR 交互。
works.technique: A camera feed is processed in real time with a max-brightness accumulation buffer, likely in custom software, so light strokes persist on the display.
works.technique_zh: 相机画面经实时处理，用最大亮度累积缓冲让光的笔画留在屏幕上，可能是自研软件。
works.exercise_en: Write a WebAR or Lens Studio effect that keeps the brightest value of each pixel over time (a live long exposure) and invite people to wave phone flashlights in front of it. Twist: the accumulated image slowly drifts upward like smoke.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 WebAR 或 Lens Studio 效果，让每个像素保留随时间出现过的最亮值（实时长曝光），请大家在镜头前挥动手机手电；变体：累积的画面像烟一样慢慢向上飘。

works.title: Kill the Lights
works.description: Glowing skeletons drawn in light dance, ride and wander through night landscapes in a stop-motion film built from long-exposure photographs.
works.description_zh: 用光画出的发光骷髅在夜晚的风景里跳舞、骑行、漫步，这部定格动画由长曝光照片组成。
works.idea_en: A character drawn only as outlines can live convincingly in a real landscape; AR characters do not need full shading to feel present.
works.idea_zh: 只用轮廓线画出的角色也能可信地活在真实风景里；AR 角色不必有完整的明暗也能让人感到它在场。
works.technique: Each frame is one long exposure in which the artist redraws the skeleton with handheld lights in a slightly new pose.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧都是一次长曝光，艺术家用手持光源把骷髅以略微不同的姿态重新画一遍。
works.exercise_en: Draw a wireframe skeleton in an AR drawing tool, rig it with a phone body-tracking skeleton so it copies a friend's dance, and anchor it outdoors at night. Twist: leave a faint trail of past poses behind each bone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 绘画工具里画一副线框骷髅，用手机人体追踪骨架驱动它模仿同伴的舞蹈，并在夜晚的户外锚定；变体：让每根骨头身后留下淡淡的过往姿态轨迹。

works.title: She Lights The Night
works.description: A glowing girl carries light through a dark world, animated from 1,012 hand-drawn light-painting photographs.
works.description_zh: 一个发光的女孩在黑暗的世界里带来光亮，动画由 1012 张手绘光绘照片组成。
works.idea_en: A light-painted character can light up its own surroundings; in AR, virtual characters that cast light on real surfaces feel far more grounded.
works.idea_zh: 光绘的角色可以照亮自身周围；在 AR 里，能把光投在真实表面上的虚拟角色显得踏实得多。
works.technique: Frame-by-frame long exposures drawn with handheld lights, sequenced into a short film.
works.technique_zh: 用手持光源逐帧绘制长曝光，再串成短片。
works.exercise_en: Place a glowing AR character in a dark room using a real-time light estimation and a point light attached to the character so it lights the scanned mesh around it. Twist: the room's real lamps dim when the character gets close.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗房间里放一个发光的 AR 角色，用实时光照估计，并给角色挂一个点光源，让它照亮周围扫描出的网格；变体：角色靠近时，房间里的真实灯（智能灯）变暗。

works.title: Fiat Lux
works.description: A narrative light-painting short in 11 scenes made from 686 long-exposure photographs straight out of the camera, telling a story entirely with drawn light.
works.description_zh: 一部由 11 个场景组成的叙事光绘短片，686 张长曝光照片全部直出，完全用画出来的光讲故事。
works.idea_en: Story beats can be staged in real locations using only drawn light; AR stories can likewise lean on sparse, glowing marks rather than heavy 3D assets.
works.idea_zh: 只用画出的光就能在真实地点演出故事情节；AR 故事同样可以依靠稀疏的发光线条，而不是笨重的三维资产。
works.technique: Hundreds of in-camera light paintings are shot as a stop-motion sequence, without compositing.
works.technique_zh: 几百张相机内完成的光绘照片按定格动画顺序拍摄，不做后期合成。
works.exercise_en: Storyboard a three-scene AR story told only with glowing line drawings anchored at three spots in a park, each scene triggered when the viewer arrives. Twist: the drawings are traced by the viewer first, then animate on their own.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个三场景的 AR 故事画分镜，只用发光线条画面，分别锚定在公园里的三个点，观众走到时触发；变体：先让观众亲手描一遍线条，线条再自己动起来。

works.title: Day to Night
works.description: From a fixed position high above a city or landscape, Wilkes shoots for up to 30 hours and blends the best moments into one photograph whose left side is day and right side is night.
works.description_zh: Wilkes 在城市或风景上方的固定高处连续拍摄长达 30 小时，把最精彩的瞬间融合成一张照片：画面一侧是白天，另一侧是夜晚。
works.idea_en: Time can be laid out across space so one glance shows a whole day: AR can map time onto a direction, letting viewers read history by looking left to right.
works.idea_zh: 时间可以铺在空间上，一眼就看到一整天：AR 可以把时间映射到一个方向上，让观众从左往右看就能读出历史。
works.technique: Hundreds to over a thousand frames from a locked camera are masked and blended so each region of the image comes from a different time.
works.technique_zh: 固定机位拍下的几百到一千多张照片经过蒙版与融合，画面的每个区域都来自不同的时间。
works.exercise_en: Record a 1-hour timelapse of a window view on a phone, then build an AR filter that shows each vertical slice of the live view from a different moment of the timelapse. Twist: tie the time gradient to the phone's compass heading instead of screen position.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一段 1 小时的窗外延时，再做一个 AR 滤镜，让实时画面的每个竖条显示延时中不同时刻的画面；变体：让时间渐变跟随手机的指南针朝向，而不是屏幕位置。

works.title: This Fragile Earth: Day to Night
works.description: Day to Night images of endangered species and habitats — waterholes, migrations, ice — where animals arriving and leaving over a day share one frame.
works.description_zh: 以《Day to Night》手法拍摄的濒危物种与栖息地——水坑、迁徙、冰原——一天中来来去去的动物同时出现在同一画面里。
works.idea_en: Compressing a day of animal visits into one image reveals patterns of use no single moment shows; AR can do the same for how people use a space.
works.idea_zh: 把一天里动物的来访压缩进一张图，就能看出任何单一时刻都看不到的使用规律；AR 也可以这样呈现人们如何使用一个空间。
works.technique: A fixed long-lens camera records a location for a full day and selected animals from different hours are composited into one scene.
works.technique_zh: 固定的长焦相机拍下某地一整天，再把不同时段的动物选出来合成到同一画面。
works.exercise_en: Log where people stand in a hallway over a day with a phone and a person-detection model, then show all positions as colored ghosts by hour in AR at the real spot. Twist: let viewers filter to one hour by turning a virtual dial.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机和人物检测模型记录一天中人们在走廊里停留的位置，再在 AR 中把所有位置按小时用不同颜色的幽灵显示在原地；变体：让观众转动一个虚拟旋钮，只看某一个小时。

works.title: Making Future Magic: iPad light painting
works.description: Moving iPads through the air during long exposures, BERG and Dentsu London draw 3D letters and objects in light: the screen shows successive slices of a 3D model, so the tablet becomes a brush that paints solid forms.
works.description_zh: BERG 与 Dentsu London 在长曝光中挥动 iPad，用光在空中画出立体的字母和物体：屏幕依次显示三维模型的截面，平板就成了能画出实体形状的画笔。
works.idea_en: A moving screen can sweep out a volume: slicing a 3D model over time is a physical preview of how AR renders form in space.
works.idea_zh: 移动的屏幕可以扫出一个体积：随时间切分三维模型，是 AR 在空间中呈现形体的一种实体预演。
works.technique: An iPad app displays cross-sections of a 3D model in sequence as the tablet is pulled through space at a steady speed during a long exposure, with stop-motion animation of the results.
works.technique_zh: iPad 应用在平板以稳定速度划过空间时依次显示三维模型的截面，配合长曝光拍摄，再把结果做成定格动画。
works.exercise_en: Write a web page that plays the slices of a simple 3D model on a phone screen, pull the phone through the air during a 10-second long exposure on a second phone, and compare with the same model placed in WebXR. Twist: use the phone's gyroscope to advance slices with real motion instead of time.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个网页，在手机屏幕上依次播放一个简单三维模型的截面，用另一部手机拍 10 秒长曝光时把它划过空中，再和放在 WebXR 里的同一个模型比较；变体：用陀螺仪按真实移动而不是时间来推进截面。

works.title: Immaterials: the ghost in the field
works.description: An RFID reader with an LED that lights up whenever it detects a tag is moved around the tag in steps and photographed with long exposures, revealing the invisible 3D shape of the reading field.
works.description_zh: 一台检测到标签就会点亮 LED 的 RFID 读卡器绕着标签一步步移动，并用长曝光拍下，把看不见的读取场的三维形状显现出来。
works.idea_en: Invisible technical fields have shapes: AR can show the real reach of sensors, beacons and NFC so people understand where interactions work.
works.idea_zh: 看不见的技术场也有形状：AR 可以显示传感器、信标和 NFC 的实际作用范围，让人明白交互在哪里有效。
works.technique: An LED on the reader is switched on only when a tag is read; stepping the reader through space during long exposures and animating the frames builds a volumetric map.
works.technique_zh: 只有读到标签时读卡器上的 LED 才会点亮；在长曝光中让读卡器按步长穿过空间，再把画面做成动画，就得到一幅体积地图。
works.exercise_en: Walk a phone around a room while logging Bluetooth signal strength from a beacon, then render each sample as a colored sphere at the phone's AR position. Twist: animate the spheres to pulse at the beacon's advertising rate.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着手机在房间里走动，同时记录一个蓝牙信标的信号强度，再把每个采样点在手机的 AR 位置上画成彩色小球；变体：让小球按信标的广播频率闪动。

works.title: Immaterials: Light painting WiFi
works.description: A 4 m rod of 80 LEDs shows the WiFi signal strength as a bar graph while it is walked through Oslo streets; long exposures turn the readings into glowing walls of data in the city.
works.description_zh: 一根装有 80 颗 LED、长 4 米的灯杆以柱状图显示 WiFi 信号强度，被人扛着走过奥斯陆街头；长曝光把这些读数变成城市中发光的数据墙。
works.idea_en: Walking a sensor through the city and drawing its readings in place is situated data visualization — the core promise of AR data overlays.
works.idea_zh: 带着传感器走过城市并在原地画出它的读数，就是“就地的数据可视化”——这正是 AR 数据叠加的核心承诺。
works.technique: A measuring rod with an LED bar graph displays live RSSI readings, photographed with long exposures as it moves along a path.
works.technique_zh: 装有 LED 柱状图的测量杆实时显示 RSSI 读数，沿路径移动时用长曝光拍下。
works.exercise_en: Log WiFi or cellular signal strength with GPS while walking a campus route, then display it as a vertical bar wall along the route in AR. Twist: let two groups log different networks and show both walls side by side.
works.exercise_zh: 沿校园路线步行，同时记录 WiFi 或蜂窝信号强度与 GPS，再在 AR 中沿路线显示成一堵竖直的柱状墙；变体：让两组人记录不同的网络，并排显示两堵墙。

works.title: Robot Readable World
works.description: A short film assembled from computer-vision research footage: tracking boxes, feature points, depth maps and labels show how machines see streets, faces and objects.
works.description_zh: 一部由计算机视觉研究影像剪成的短片：追踪框、特征点、深度图和标签展示了机器如何“看见”街道、人脸和物体。
works.idea_en: The machine's view is itself a visual language; exposing tracking points and meshes can be a deliberate AR aesthetic instead of a debug mode.
works.idea_zh: 机器的视角本身就是一种视觉语言；把追踪点和网格暴露出来，可以是一种有意为之的 AR 美学，而不只是调试模式。
works.technique: Found footage from computer-vision demos, with overlays of feature detection, segmentation and tracking, edited into a single film.
works.technique_zh: 把计算机视觉演示中的现有影像（带特征检测、分割和追踪的叠加）剪辑成一部影片。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR filter that renders only the debug layers of AR tracking — feature points, plane meshes, depth — as the main visual style, and film a walk through a building with it. Twist: let the mesh age and fade so the machine's memory of the room becomes visible.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 滤镜，只把 AR 追踪的调试层——特征点、平面网格、深度——当作主要视觉风格来渲染，并用它拍一段在建筑中穿行的视频；变体：让网格随时间老化褪色，把机器对房间的“记忆”显现出来。

works.title: Theaters
works.description: Sugimoto opens his large-format camera's shutter when a film starts in a cinema or drive-in and closes it when the film ends; the screen becomes a pure white rectangle lighting the empty auditorium. Here he shows the camera he used.
works.description_zh: 杉本博司在电影院或汽车影院里，电影开场时打开大画幅相机的快门，散场时再关上；银幕变成一块纯白的矩形，照亮空荡的观众厅。视频中他展示了当年用的相机。
works.idea_en: Adding up an entire film yields only light: an AR piece can show the sum of everything that happened in a place rather than any single moment.
works.idea_zh: 把一整部电影叠加起来，只剩下光：AR 作品可以展示一个地方发生过的一切的总和，而不是某一个瞬间。
works.technique: A single exposure lasting the length of a feature film (about two hours) on large-format film.
works.technique_zh: 在大画幅胶片上进行一次与整部电影同长（约两小时）的曝光。
works.exercise_en: Write a Lens Studio or WebAR effect that averages the camera feed over the whole session and shows the average as a live overlay; point it at a TV, a street or a busy desk for 10 minutes. Twist: blend the average with the live view based on how long the phone has stayed still.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 Lens Studio 或 WebAR 效果，把整段使用过程中的相机画面取平均并作为实时叠加显示；对着电视、街道或忙碌的桌面拍 10 分钟；变体：按手机保持静止的时长，把平均画面和实时画面混合。

works.title: Seascapes
works.description: Horizons of seas around the world, each split exactly in half between water and sky, photographed with long exposures in the same format for decades; discussed here in a Louisiana Channel interview.
works.description_zh: 世界各地的海平面，每张都正好一半是水、一半是天，数十年来用同样的构图和长曝光拍摄；视频是 Louisiana Channel 的访谈。
works.idea_en: One fixed rule repeated across many places makes a whole series feel like one view: AR installations can use a constant framing to connect distant sites.
works.idea_zh: 在许多地方重复同一条固定规则，整个系列就像同一个视角：AR 装置可以用固定的取景把遥远的地点连在一起。
works.technique: Large-format camera with long exposures and a fixed composition that places the horizon at the exact center of the frame.
works.technique_zh: 大画幅相机长曝光，构图固定，让地平线正好位于画面中央。
works.exercise_en: Make a WebXR portal that always shows a sea horizon at eye level, aligned with the viewer's real horizon using the device's gravity vector, and place it in a windowless room. Twist: the sea's time of day follows the local time of a coastline on the other side of the world.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 传送门，利用设备的重力方向让一条海平线始终与观众的真实视平线对齐，把它放在没有窗的房间里；变体：海面的时刻跟随地球另一端某段海岸的当地时间。

works.title: Neighbours
works.description: Two men fight over a flower in an Oscar-winning anti-war film shot as pixilation: live actors are photographed one frame at a time so they glide, float and move impossibly.
works.description_zh: 两个男人为一朵花大打出手——这部获奥斯卡奖的反战片用“逐格真人动画”拍摄：真人演员被一帧一帧地拍，于是可以滑行、漂浮、做出不可能的动作。
works.idea_en: Sampling a real body at the wrong rate makes it move like a cartoon; AR frame-dropping and pose-snapping can give real people superpowers.
works.idea_zh: 用“错误”的速率采样真实的身体，它就会像卡通一样动；AR 中的丢帧和姿态跳接可以给真人赋予超能力。
works.technique: Pixilation: actors hold poses for single frames while the camera advances, creating motion that could not be filmed continuously.
works.technique_zh: 逐格真人动画：演员每拍一帧就摆好一个姿势，相机逐帧推进，产生无法连续拍摄的运动。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR 'pixilation booth' that captures a person segmentation mask only when they jump, and plays the captures back so they appear to float across the floor. Twist: two people take turns so their clips interleave into one fight.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR“逐格真人动画”拍摄台：只在人跳起时截取人像分割，再回放这些截图，让人看起来在地面上飘过；变体：两人轮流拍，把片段交错成一场打斗。

works.title: Pas de deux
works.description: Two dancers lit from the side against black are printed on top of themselves with frame delays, so every movement unfolds into a fan of luminous echoes.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者在黑色背景前被侧光照亮，影像以不同的帧延迟叠印在自身之上，每个动作都展开成一扇发光的回声。
works.idea_en: Delayed copies of a body turn movement into form; the same echo effect on a live AR body track makes dance visible as sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 身体的延迟副本把动作变成形体；把同样的回声效果加在 AR 实时身体追踪上，舞蹈就会像雕塑一样被看见。
works.technique: Optical printing: the same film strip is exposed repeatedly with offsets of several frames, stacking time-shifted images of the dancers.
works.technique_zh: 光学印片：同一条胶片以相差若干帧的方式多次曝光，把时间错开的舞者影像叠在一起。
works.exercise_en: Create a body-segmentation effect in Lens Studio or WebAR that draws the last 8 masks of a dancer with delays of 3 frames each and decreasing opacity. Twist: map the delay length to the music's tempo.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 WebAR 中做一个人像分割效果，把舞者最近 8 个遮罩以每个延迟 3 帧、透明度递减的方式画出来；变体：让延迟长度跟随音乐的节拍速度。

works.title: Ballet Adagio
works.description: A classical pas de deux filmed at high speed and played back in slow motion, so the lifts and balances unfold with a clarity the live audience never sees.
works.description_zh: 一段古典双人舞用高速摄影拍摄并以慢动作播放，托举和平衡动作展开得清清楚楚，这是现场观众从未见过的。
works.idea_en: Slowing time exposes the mechanics of skill; AR replays of real performers at slow speed make an effective teaching layer.
works.idea_zh: 放慢时间能暴露技巧背后的力学；以慢速回放真实表演者的 AR 影像，是一层很有效的教学内容。
works.technique: High-speed cinematography played back at normal speed, stretching each second of movement into several.
works.technique_zh: 以高速摄影拍摄、按正常速度放映，把每一秒的动作拉长成好几秒。
works.exercise_en: Record a dancer or athlete volumetrically with a depth-capable phone app and place the capture life-size in AR at 1/4 speed so students can walk around a lift. Twist: add a floor marker that shows where the center of mass is at each moment.
works.exercise_zh: 用支持深度的手机应用对舞者或运动员做体积捕捉，在 AR 中按真人大小以 1/4 速度回放，让学生绕着托举动作走一圈；变体：在地面加一个标记，显示每一刻重心的位置。

works.title: Narcissus
works.description: McLaren's last film retells the Narcissus myth as a ballet, using mirror images, multiple exposures and slow motion so the dancer duets with his own reflection.
works.description_zh: McLaren 的最后一部作品以芭蕾重述纳西索斯神话，用镜像、多重曝光和慢动作让舞者与自己的倒影共舞。
works.idea_en: Dancing with your own copy is a compelling interaction: a delayed or mirrored AR clone of the user makes a partner out of oneself.
works.idea_zh: 与自己的副本共舞是很有吸引力的交互：一个延迟或镜像的 AR 分身能让人把自己变成舞伴。
works.technique: Mirror printing, multiple exposure and slow-motion cinematography composited on an optical printer.
works.technique_zh: 在光学印片机上合成镜像印片、多重曝光和慢动作画面。
works.exercise_en: Capture a person with body tracking and spawn a mirrored clone that repeats their moves 2 seconds later beside them in AR. Twist: the clone slowly stops copying and starts improvising.
works.exercise_zh: 用身体追踪捕捉一个人，在 AR 中他身边生成一个镜像分身，延迟 2 秒重复他的动作；变体：分身慢慢不再模仿，开始自己即兴。

works.title: Urban Flow
works.description: Slit-scan panoramas of pedestrians crossing one line on a street: each person is recorded as they pass, so the image is a row of people from different moments, discussed here in a short documentary.
works.description_zh: 对街上一条线进行狭缝扫描拍摄的行人全景：每个人都在走过那条线时被记录下来，于是画面是一排来自不同时刻的人；视频是一部介绍他作品的短纪录片。
works.idea_en: A camera that records only one line turns time into the horizontal axis; AR slit-scan filters can make the passage of people readable at a glance.
works.idea_zh: 只记录一条线的相机把时间变成了横轴；AR 狭缝扫描滤镜可以让人流的经过一目了然。
works.technique: An industrial line-scan camera records a single column of pixels thousands of times per second, stacking them into an image where x is time (year of first works approximate).
works.technique_zh: 工业线扫描相机每秒对同一列像素记录数千次，把它们堆叠成一张横轴代表时间的图像（首批作品年份为大致时间）。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR slit-scan: take the center column of the camera feed each frame and append it to a growing panorama displayed on a virtual wall in AR. Twist: let the user rotate the slit to horizontal and see what changes.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebAR 狭缝扫描：每帧取相机画面的中间一列像素，追加到一幅不断变长的全景上，并显示在 AR 的一面虚拟墙上；变体：让用户把狭缝转成水平方向，看看会有什么不同。

works.title: Stainless — Shinjuku
works.description: A camera on a moving subway train records the waiting crowd on Shinjuku station's platform at a very high frame rate; played back, the commuters seem almost frozen, like living statues sliding past.
works.description_zh: 安装在行驶列车上的相机以极高帧率拍下新宿站台上等车的人群；回放时通勤者几乎静止，就像一排滑过的活雕塑。
works.idea_en: Changing the time scale of a crowd turns strangers into portraits; AR can slow a busy place down so people notice the individuals in it.
works.idea_zh: 改变人群的时间尺度，陌生人就变成了肖像；AR 可以把繁忙的地方放慢，让人注意到其中的每一个人。
works.technique: A custom rig built around an industrial high-speed camera, mounted in the train, records hundreds of frames per second so seconds stretch into minutes.
works.technique_zh: 装在列车上、以工业高速相机为核心的改装设备每秒记录数百帧，把几秒钟拉长成几分钟。
works.exercise_en: Film a busy corridor at 240 fps from a slowly moving cart, then place the clip at 1/10 speed as a window in AR on the same wall it was filmed along. Twist: faces become sharp only when the viewer stops walking.
works.exercise_zh: 推着小车以 240 fps 慢慢拍一条繁忙的走廊，在 AR 中把这段 1/10 速度的影像作为一扇窗贴在当初拍摄的那面墙上；变体：只有观众停下脚步时人脸才会变清晰。

works.title: Tango
works.description: In one small room, 36 characters from different stages of life enter, loop through their actions and leave, all overlapping in time yet never colliding; the film won the 1983 Oscar for animated short.
works.description_zh: 在一个小房间里，36 个处于不同人生阶段的人物进来、循环着各自的动作、再离开，他们在时间上重叠却从不相撞；影片获 1983 年奥斯卡最佳动画短片奖。
works.idea_en: Many looping recordings can share one real room if their paths are choreographed; AR spaces can hold layers of past visitors without clutter.
works.idea_zh: 只要路径编排得当，许多循环的录像可以共享同一个真实房间；AR 空间可以容纳层层叠叠的过往访客而不显杂乱。
works.technique: Each actor was filmed separately and composited through thousands of hand-cut mattes and multiple exposures on an optical printer.
works.technique_zh: 每位演员单独拍摄，再用几千张手工切割的遮罩和多次曝光在光学印片机上合成。
works.exercise_en: Record 5 people separately walking short loops through the same corner of a room with phone volumetric or segmentation capture, then replay all loops together in AR at their original positions. Twist: add a 6th loop live — the viewer — and see who collides.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机体积捕捉或人像分割，分别录下 5 个人在房间同一角落走的短循环，再在 AR 中按原位置把所有循环同时回放；变体：加入第 6 个实时循环——观众本人——看谁会撞上谁。

works.title: Steps
works.description: A group of American tourists is keyed into the Odessa Steps sequence of Eisenstein's Battleship Potemkin, walking among the historic footage in an early HD video composite.
works.description_zh: 一群美国游客被抠像合成进爱森斯坦《战舰波将金号》的敖德萨阶梯段落里，在历史影像中走来走去，这是早期的高清视频合成。
works.idea_en: Placing living people inside historic footage is the ancestor of AR history walks; the friction between the two times is the content.
works.idea_zh: 把活人放进历史影像里，是 AR 历史漫步的前身；两个时代之间的摩擦本身就是内容。
works.technique: Blue-screen video keying and early high-definition compositing combine new actors with the 1925 film footage.
works.technique_zh: 用蓝幕抠像和早期高清合成，把新拍的演员与 1925 年的电影画面组合在一起。
works.exercise_en: Find a historic photo of a place on campus, align it as an AR overlay at the exact spot, and let visitors photograph themselves standing inside it. Twist: the historic people slowly turn to look at the visitor.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张校园某处的老照片，把它作为 AR 叠加精确对准在原地，让来访者拍下自己站在老照片里的样子；变体：照片里的历史人物慢慢转头看向来访者。

works.title: The Fourth Dimension
works.description: People, objects and landscapes twist and ripple because each horizontal line of the image is delayed by one more frame than the line above, turning time into a visible spatial distortion.
works.description_zh: 人物、物体和风景扭曲起伏，因为画面中每一条水平线都比上一条多延迟一帧，时间因此变成可见的空间变形。
works.idea_en: Delaying each row of the image makes time bend bodies; slit-scan is one of the simplest and strongest time-warp effects for AR cameras.
works.idea_zh: 让画面的每一行依次延迟，时间就会把身体弯曲；狭缝扫描是 AR 相机最简单也最有力的时间扭曲效果之一。
works.technique: Slit-scan by scanlines: frames are rebuilt so each of about 480 lines comes from a progressively later frame.
works.technique_zh: 按扫描线做狭缝扫描：重组画面，让约 480 条线各自取自越来越晚的帧。
works.exercise_en: Implement a time-displacement shader in Lens Studio or three.js that samples a ring buffer of camera frames with a delay proportional to screen y, then film a friend spinning. Twist: drive the delay by a depth map so near objects warp more than far ones.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 three.js 里写一个时间位移着色器，从相机帧环形缓冲中按屏幕 y 坐标成比例的延迟取样，然后拍同伴原地转圈；变体：用深度图控制延迟，让近处物体比远处扭曲得更厉害。

works.title: Open Shutter: Long-Exposure Construction Series
works.description: Cameras with tiny apertures stay open for up to three years over building sites such as Potsdamer Platz in Berlin, MoMA in New York and IMS Paulista in São Paulo, so cranes and new towers appear as translucent layers.
works.description_zh: 孔径极小的相机在柏林波茨坦广场、纽约 MoMA、圣保罗 IMS Paulista 等工地上方持续曝光长达三年，塔吊和新楼都以半透明图层的形式出现。
works.idea_en: A site's history can be shown as translucent layers in one view; AR 'time layers' over buildings can borrow this ghosted look.
works.idea_zh: 一个地方的历史可以在同一视图里显示为半透明的层；叠加在建筑上的 AR“时间图层”可以借用这种幽灵般的视觉。
works.technique: Custom cameras with very small apertures and heavy filtering expose one sheet of film for months or years (series from 1997 onward).
works.technique_zh: 自制相机采用极小光圈和重度滤镜，让一张底片曝光数月甚至数年（系列始于 1997 年）。
works.exercise_en: Collect 10 photos of one building from different years (archives, Street View history), align them in AR over the real facade, and blend them with a slider. Twist: let each layer appear only when the viewer stands where that photo was taken.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同一栋建筑不同年份的 10 张照片（档案、街景历史），在 AR 中与真实立面对齐，并用滑块混合；变体：只有观众站到当年拍摄的位置时，对应的图层才出现。

leads.name: Pe Lang
leads.why: Swiss kinetic artist and Zimoun's collaborator; precise magnetic and motor-driven minimal kinetic works with gallery videos (bitforms).

leads.name: Lyman Whitaker
leads.why: American wind sculptor ('Whitaker Wind Sculptures'), large outdoor fields of spinning copper forms; strong land-plus-kinetic reference.

leads.name: Tim Prentice
leads.why: Kinetic wind-wall pioneer whose façades of small hanging panels predate Ned Kahn's; few own videos, needs a search.

leads.name: Bob Potts
leads.why: Kinetic sculptor of slow rowing/flying mechanical forms (e.g. 'Ascension'); gallery videos exist.

leads.name: David C. Roy
leads.why: Wooden wind-up kinetic sculptures with long-running moiré motion; many own videos.

leads.name: Robert Henke
leads.why: Co-author of ATOM, GRID and DEEP WEB with Christopher Bauder; his laser work Lumière is strong light/stage material (sky-light agent may cover it).

leads.name: mischer'traxler
leads.why: Vienna design duo; Ephemerā and Curiosity Cloud are responsive kinetic installations where objects react to visitors.

leads.name: Yunchul Kim
leads.why: Korean artist of fluid and kinetic sculptures (Chroma III, Argos); strong kinetic material.

leads.name: Balint Bolygo
leads.why: Makes pendulum and drawing machines that trace motion (trace category).

leads.name: Johannes Langkamp
leads.why: Dutch artist of kinetic light and camera installations (The Movement of Space).

leads.name: ART+COM — more kinetic works
leads.why: Their Vimeo also has Reactive Sparks (2008), Resonance and Infinite Cube (Reflective Kinematronic I/III), Manta Rhei (2012), Grasp Pendulum (2010) and The Invisible Shape of Things Past (1999).

leads.name: Troika — Light Rain, Borrowed Light, The Sum of All Possibilities
leads.why: Further Troika works with official uploads: Light Rain (UK Pavilion Shanghai 2010, sEa_3Q7qFOA), Borrowed Light at the Barbican (L7_1z73twdE), The Sum of All Possibilities (Daelim Museum, 9CjXr9YWtio).

leads.name: United Visual Artists — Musica Universalis, Great Animal Orchestra
leads.why: 180 Fact uploads of Musica Universalis (AZoiAeYfoVk) and The Great Animal Orchestra with Bernie Krause (immersive, o1SnSv0OQdY).

leads.name: A.A. Murakami — Floating World
leads.why: Immersive mist-bubble installation (MFAH, 2023) by the former Studio Swine.

leads.name: Marcelo Coelho & Jamie Zigelbaum
leads.why: Six-Forty by Four-Eighty (2011): physical light 'pixels' you pick up and rearrange on a wall, which pass colours through touch — a tangible responsive display.

leads.name: Miguel Chevalier
leads.why: Fractal Flowers and other generative responsive environments that grow virtual plants around visitors; long career in projected responsive installations.

leads.name: Chico MacMurtrie — Pneuma Fountain
leads.why: Recent inflatable responsive piece shown at Ars Electronica; year and details not verified in this pass.

leads.name: Jason Bruges Studio — Pixel Cloud / Constellation / Panda Eyes / Platform 5
leads.why: Further responsive works; studio videos exist (Panda Eyes WCce646GqIE, Platform 5 6hZ2Yardg4s, Aerial Dynamics l0ND7Z04YbM, Mirror Mirror QLKUMbl166U) but years and descriptions could not be confirmed without the studio site.

leads.name: Wen-Ying Tsai
leads.why: Cybernetic sculptor (strobe-lit vibrating steel rods that respond to sound, 1960s–70s); only YouTube hit (TSAIBERNETICS, Łaźnia Gdańsk, L6xIZ9cMXS8) is unavailable, no other playable video found.

leads.name: Naum Gabo
leads.why: Kinetic Construction (Standing Wave, 1919–20) is the first motorised kinetic sculpture, but no video of it moving was found (only static Tate St Ives visits).

leads.name: Heinz Mack
leads.why: ZERO co-founder with Piene; Light Dynamo (1963) and light rotors are motorised light kinetics (artdone UDKw6xcHiS0, museumabteiberg kNEKdpXI2WQ).

leads.name: Gruppo T (Giovanni Anceschi, Davide Boriani, Gabriele Devecchi, Grazia Varisco)
leads.why: Milan programmed-art group of Gianni Colombo; early interactive/kinetic environments (Ambienti del Gruppo T).

leads.name: Niki de Saint Phalle
leads.why: Co-author of Le Cyclop and the Stravinsky Fountain (with Tinguely): kinetic fountain sculptures in public space.

leads.name: Janne Parviainen
leads.why: Finnish light-painting artist who draws glowing figures and 'light bodies' in real rooms and landscapes; strong trace-category candidate, videos on YouTube (e.g. Cambridge Creation Lab talk).

leads.name: Jason D. Page
leads.why: Light-painting artist and founder of LightPaintingPhotography.com; documentary available, could extend the light-painting cluster.

leads.name: Pablo Rochat
leads.why: Checked for time/motion work: his output is visual gags and ads (Nike shorts, AI work), not time or motion traces.
